I’m reaching out to you today because I’m running for Congress in Nevada’s 3rd District, **but I’m not what you might expect...**

Friend, Monday was Tax Day―a day when regular people do their civic duty of paying taxes, which support crucial investments in our communities. **Unfortunately, due to a rigged tax system, those at the very top are not paying their fair share,** which starves public services of the resources we need from healthcare to education to housing, nutrition, and more. **That’s why I’m proud to be an original co-sponsor of the**** _Ultra-Millionaire Tax Act_****,** which would apply a 2% tax on the wealth of households and trusts worth between $50 million and $1 billion, and a 2% tax on fortunes exceeding $1 billion. **This bill would raise at least $3 trillion in new tax revenue over 10 years from the wealthiest 0.05%―or 100,000 households.** At a time when the number of billionaires in the U.S. has reached a record 806 and when the richest 1% now hold $44 trillion in collective wealth, the _Ultra-Millionaire Tax Act_ is a critical tool for addressing our nation’s destabilizing wealth gap, particularly impacting low-income Black, Latino, and Native households. [**Add your name now as a grassroots co-sponsor of the**** _Ultra-Millionaire Tax Act_****and join me in demanding Congress unrig our tax code and require the very wealthiest households to pay their fair share.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39uDKkapQVnT18L0ER7M9FmwH56BiZUa8B4InAnYjFsD9SOcPz4HE978ZnTfc8cO7D8p1JyK_uEWz41xevPtyokqsAfB5uXYd21X6wEK7k9PU1skXg_Ezn9gilc09IM_ELpdrgFUuYv1eSAPrdcxRqV2WD0ZO4ASpnvptWLf6br8BmFdUsb7FsrdilKmSPcTK7OYz0q-dohC8JsTFc-PFVzCu1dlsfkv_XTDg8IxfhHlVpA8UQsliW0gJwJXoE_3Qt8yLcuusS8a3eDLOCouSIveBELfRzfyw0ZQSewfwwYjq6kzkDvEKL0JMkb782AJt_nMOcj06DQ26LeBetkvxEmtckkipeQ8S3O2a5RN8KXf7BPSCs7hMW1XAPPTF4ebiokx7FJYiKvHZX9kO9mKDgjkbx6167PkkSIKJsAwtXzUc1LLbN6XqTIVD5H4tpjtpJU_tjLJGRyW3cTlcA7US2G_UkzBsbRqQDFVdWCo3zH9fYXe4nj5YrkrvGh1Ujj50Q-Wp0d39bnFPrKCFcljGDShwQZ6OcM_tRAZXGQHzl8iS-uQVF1va3-7_WtznzI0d6WFCcLolK_Nynr1_TI61XMNCqde3zAJSqeV81rxKyYMw/45m/YEoxUwP_RhGKlAnM1Rcz3Q/h1/h001.sQZClmX7gO7aD_zTwPKna7XDpNjSF-0LbkVU5T5Iz2g) | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39uDKkapQVnT18L0ER7M9FmwH56BiZUa8B4InAnYjFsD9SOcPz4HE978ZnTfc8cO7D8p1JyK_uEWz41xevPtyokqsAfB5uXYd21X6wEK7k9PU1skXg_Ezn9gilc09IM_ELpdrgFUuYv1eSAPrdcxRqV2WD0ZO4ASpnvptWLf6br8BmFdUsb7FsrdilKmSPcTK7OYz0q-dohC8JsTFc-PFVzCu1dlsfkv_XTDg8IxfhHlVpA8UQsliW0gJwJXoE_3Qt8yLcuusS8a3eDLOCouSIveBELfRzfyw0ZQSewfwwYjq6kzkDvEKL0JMkb782AJt_nMOcj06DQ26LeBetkvxEmafzPKf7ZfgJ684uDnu9d8MexoUjckVIMYSU6PJeQEN2_OBcfS_UjnzlLQSxi2NtAP-J2A6t2xbU9v_Q6jULkIRGpmoUwtwLTnW5sRSviHu00mheopgAHt-hAmLBYOvNrAWeSuKtYf1SMgeTGDjXW2CgGFm7hJjc7_WgKQvb8c19aYs_JPoWHJt1WmHpHshHSqOEp_JwJmh9h3ORB0Us6XggcJL_ZJaMxQEKUqzmweBYIfJav8EqmfScUhVGWexqBjon0vFPG4rkdIC1Fj0krmg/45m/YEoxUwP_RhGKlAnM1Rcz3Q/h2/h001.azGJqBbV9QOo_ulyEPUuoMtStFU_njaiU_8yRCDD_g4)

As recently as 2020, 400 of the richest Americans―almost exclusively white men―held more wealth than all 10 million Black U.S. households combined. So, demanding more from billionaires is an issue of racial justice.

clean_body: The richest 400 Americans hold more wealth than all 10 million Black U.S. households. | | | Friend, Monday was Tax Day―a day when regular people do their civic duty of paying taxes, which support crucial investments in our communities. Unfortunately, due to a rigged tax system, those at the very top are not paying their fair share, which starves public services of the resources we need from healthcare to education to housing, nutrition, and more. That’s why I’m proud to be an original co-sponsor of the Ultra-Millionaire Tax Act, which would apply a 2% tax on the wealth of households and trusts worth between $50 million and $1 billion, and a 2% tax on fortunes exceeding $1 billion. This bill would raise at least $3 trillion in new tax revenue over 10 years from the wealthiest 0.05%―or 100,000 households. At a time when the number of billionaires in the U.S. has reached a record 806 and when the richest 1% now hold $44 trillion in collective wealth, the Ultra-Millionaire Tax Act is a critical tool for addressing our nation’s destabilizing wealth gap, particularly impacting low-income Black, Latino, and Native households. | As recently as 2020, 400 of the richest Americans―almost exclusively white men―held more wealth than all 10 million Black U.S. households combined. So, demanding more from billionaires is an issue of racial justice. Because Congressional Republicans systematically gutted the IRS budget between 2010 and 2020, the audits of millionaires and billionaires dropped by 92% during that time. The Ultra-Millionaire Tax Act would mandate that at least 30% of these ultra-wealthy households be audited each year, and would provide the IRS with the funding needed to crack down on ultra-wealthy tax cheats. body:
Friday Night - 6:00-9:30PM - DeKoven House, Middletown | |
---
| | |
# 2024 Launch Party on Friday!
GIVE, GROOVE & BE GREEN
Green Party of Connecticut
Friday, April 19: 6:00 to 9:30 PM
DeKoven House, Middletown
---
|
---
|
---
|
### Do you have plans Friday night? Want to do something fun? Please join the Green Party of CT for our 2024 campaign season kickoff, with live music, catered food & cash bar!

**LIVE Music from[Paddy Whack](https://justin4all.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d3bf03d4d24177d79cb656ca&id=8024e6e09e&e=91a3f04de5), [Hugh Birdsall](https://justin4all.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d3bf03d4d24177d79cb656ca&id=5b72536540&e=91a3f04de5), and [Post Traumatic Jazz Disorder](https://justin4all.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d3bf03d4d24177d79cb656ca&id=10fea012c6&e=91a3f04de5) _(featuring Justin Paglino on keys)_

Live Auction - [Submit your items for auction here.](https://justin4all.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d3bf03d4d24177d79cb656ca&id=04823a3993&e=91a3f04de5)

_Petitioner Training_ \- We need 7,500 signatures in CT by August - come get your petitions!

Rousing Campaign Launch Speeches by _US Senate Candidate Justin Paglino, US House Candidate Mary Sanders, CT Senate Candidate David Bedell, and others._

Catered Meal - Cash Bar - Mix and Mingle and talk Green Politics!**

A night to remember - please come be a part of it!

**FRIDAY APRIL 19
6:00 to 9:30 PM
DeKoven House
27 Washington St, Middletown, CT**
---
| | Can't make it to the event Friday, but still want to support our petition efforts? We need funding to hire more paid petitioners! Please donate [HERE](https://justin4all.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d3bf03d4d24177d79cb656ca&id=4aa0a588a3&e=91a3f04de5).
---
|
---
|
### Dear Green Party of New Haven, my apologies for the long hiatus in chapter activity - your chair has been extremely busy. As some of you will know, since November I have been employed as the Field Director for Jill Stein for President 2024. This has been a labor of love for me - Jill Stein is the president we need for People, Planet, and Peace. Please [sign up for the campaign](https://justin4all.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d3bf03d4d24177d79cb656ca&id=783e7b173e&e=91a3f04de5), and [reach out to me](mailto:justin@jillstein2024.com?subject=I%20want%20to%20volunteer!) to get involved!
---
|
---
|
## **We are the Party of People, Planet, and Peace!**
---
|
#### The need for an independent left party is clear. We are an ecosocialist peace party who fight for social, economic, electoral, and environmental justice. Come to our meetings and events to meet us and get involved!
---
| _The Greater New Haven Green Party_ is a chapter
of the Green Party of Connecticut!
Find our chapter Bylaws [HERE](https://justin4all.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d3bf03d4d24177d79cb656ca&id=c3e35d3f4b&e=91a3f04de5).

name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: Did you hear what the Supreme Court did now? / ¿Escuchaste lo que hizo la Suprema Corte ahora?
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
Who Needs Free Speech Anyway?
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Protest%20Texas%20Supreme%20Court%20ruling.jpg]
In a remarkable win for oppression, the Supreme Court has effectively put an end to mass protests in three U.S. states, and you guessed it – Texas is one of the three! [https://newrepublic.com/post/180705/supreme-court-massive-blow-right-protest]
Have something to say? Feel like you aren’t being heard? Want to speak up for what you believe is right? Welp, the Supreme Court has just made it THAT much harder to voice dissent.
This will continue, like most things, to be particularly harmful to our most marginalized communities. They know we have more power collectively then separate, and this is another attempt to keep us in silos to stop us from organizing.
It’s more important now than ever that we make sure our voices are heard. The continued attempts from the far-right to silence us continue to confirm at least one thing: They see our power.
SB4 "Know Your Rights" Trainings are Coming to Dallas and San Antonio
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/SB4%20Texas%202024.jpeg]
SB4 [https://www.keranews.org/texas-news/2024-04-02/texas-immigration-enforcement-bill-sb4-is-back-in-federal-appeals-court-wednesday] is a racist law that is wholly rooted in white supremacy. This anti-immigrant law will effectively give license to local law enforcement to criminalize and incarcerate Black and Latino immigrants.
It’s more important now than ever to ensure that we are all properly equipped with the necessary knowledge to protect ourselves against this dangerous and completely unconstitutional law.
TOP will be hosting “Know Your Rights” trainings in San Antonio and Dallas on April 27 .
San Antonio, meet us at the Westfall Branch Library from 12:30 - 2:30 p.m. Click here to RSVP and for more information! [https://secure.everyaction.com/T-9x9P2RKE2ScFBfgD7dkQ2]
Dallas, meet us at the Arcadia Park Library from 2 - 4 p.m. Click here to RSVP and for more information! [https://secure.everyaction.com/2fzwOhTUT0WFZHFbx-Q3dw2]
We want to hear your thoughts on housing justice, Dallas!
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Housing%20justice%20hand%20graphic.png]
Hey Dallas! Do you believe dignified housing is a RIGHT not a PRIVILEGE? We want to hear from you!
Come advocate for housing policy so that every tenant in Dallas gets the dignity and respect that they deserve.
Join our virtual Dallas TOP Housing Justice Campaign meeting on Thursday, April 25 at 5:30 p.m. to help plan the next phase of our local campaign.
RSVP here! [https://secure.everyaction.com/955RSuH_IUa6Pv_mvergCQ2]
TOP Tip: Stream "Stronger Together"
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Updated%20Spotify%20TOP.jpg]
Need a new organizing anthem? We’ve got you covered. Several TOP staff and members came together to create a song to commemorate and capture the spirit of our journey toward becoming a truly Pro-Black organization.
🎵 Stream TOP’s Stronger Together [https://open.spotify.com/track/078Rx6LzFaxHg6gkHUJX1T?si=7c8b6eab865748db] 🎵
Español
¿ Quién necesita libertad de expresión?
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Protest%20Texas%20Supreme%20Court%20ruling.jpg]
En una notable victoria para la opresión, la Suprema Corte efectivamente puso fin a las protestas masivas en tres estados de Estados Unidos, y lo adivinaste: ¡Texas es uno de los tres! [https://newrepublic.com/post/180705/supreme-court-massive-blow-right-protest]
¿Tener algo que decir? ¿Sientes que no te escuchan? ¿Quieres defender lo que crees que es correcto? Bueno, la Suprema Corte acaba de hacer que sea mucho más difícil expresar desacuerdo.
Esto seguirá, como la mayoría de las cosas, siendo particularmente perjudicial para nuestras comunidades más marginadas. Saben que tenemos más poder colectivamente que separados, y este es otro intento de mantenernos en silos para impedir que nos organicemos.
Ahora es más importante que nunca que nos aseguremos de que nuestras voces sean escuchadas. Los continuos intentos de la extrema derecha de silenciarnos continúan confirmando al menos una cosa: ven nuestro poder.
Los entrenamientos SB4 "Conozca sus derechos" llegarán a Dallas y San Antonio
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/SB4%20Texas%202024.jpeg]
La SB4 [https://www.keranews.org/texas-news/2024-04-02/texas-immigration-enforcement-bill-sb4-is-back-in-federal-appeals-court-wednesday] es una ley racista que está totalmente arraigada en la supremacía blanca. Esta ley antiinmigrante efectivamente otorgará licencia a las autoridades locales para criminalizar y encarcelar a inmigrantes negros y latinos. Ahora es más importante que nunca garantizar que todos estemos adecuadamente equipados con los conocimientos necesarios para protegernos contra esta ley peligrosa y completamente inconstitucional.
TOP va a dar un entrenamiento “Conozca sus derechos” en los condados de Bexar y Dallas el 27 de abril.
Bexar, reúnanse con nosotros en la biblioteca sucursal de Westfall de 12:30 a 2:30 p. m. ¡Haz clic aquí para confirmar tu asistencia y obtener más información! [https://secure.everyaction.com/T-9x9P2RKE2ScFBfgD7dkQ2]
Dallas, reúnanse con nosotros en la biblioteca de Arcadia Park de 2:00 a 4:00 p. m. ¡Haz clic aquí para confirmar tu asistencia y obtener más información! [https://secure.everyaction.com/2fzwOhTUT0WFZHFbx-Q3dw2]
¡ Queremos escuchar su opinión sobre la justicia de vivienda!
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Housing%20justice%20hand%20graphic.png]
¡Hola Dallas! ¿Crees que la vivienda digna es un DERECHO y no un PRIVILEGIO? ¡Queremos escuchar de ti! Ven a defender la política de vivienda para que todos los inquilinos de Dallas obtengan la dignidad y el respeto que merecen.
Únete a nuestra reunión virtual de la campaña de vivienda el jueves 25 de abril a las 5:30 p.m. para ayudar a planificar la siguiente fase de nuestra campaña local.
¡Confirma tu asistencia aquí! [https://secure.everyaction.com/955RSuH_IUa6Pv_mvergCQ2]
Consejos de TOP: Escucha la canción de TOP "Stronger Together"
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Updated%20Spotify%20TOP.jpg]
¿Necesitas un nuevo himno organizador? Te tenemos cubierto. Varios miembros y personal de TOP se reunieron para crear una canción para conmemorar y capturar el espíritu de nuestro viaje para convertirnos en una organización verdaderamente pro-Negra.

They know we have more power collectively then separate, and this is another attempt to keep us in silos to stop us from organizing. It’s more important now than ever that we make sure our voices are heard. The continued attempts from the far-right to silence us continue to confirm at least one thing: They see our power. SB4 "Know Your Rights" Trainings are Coming to Dallas and San Antonio [] SB4 [] is a racist law that is wholly rooted in white supremacy. This anti-immigrant law will effectively give license to local law enforcement to criminalize and incarcerate Black and Latino immigrants. It’s more important now than ever to ensure that we are all properly equipped with the necessary knowledge to protect ourselves against this dangerous and completely unconstitutional law. TOP will be hosting “Know Your Rights” trainings in San Antonio and Dallas on April 27 . San Antonio, meet us at the Westfall Branch Library from 12:30 - 2:30 p.m. Click here to RSVP and for more information! [] Dallas, meet us at the Arcadia Park Library from 2 - 4 p.m. Click here to RSVP and for more information! [] We want to hear your thoughts on housing justice, Dallas! [] Hey Dallas! Do you believe dignified housing is a RIGHT not a PRIVILEGE? We want to hear from you! Come advocate for housing policy so that every tenant in Dallas gets the dignity and respect that they deserve. Join our virtual Dallas TOP Housing Justice Campaign meeting on Thursday, April 25 at 5:30 p.m. to help plan the next phase of our local campaign. RSVP here! [] TOP Tip: Stream "Stronger Together" [] Need a new organizing anthem? We’ve got you covered. Several TOP staff and members came together to create a song to commemorate and capture the spirit of our journey toward becoming a truly Pro-Black organization. 🎵 Stream TOP’s Stronger Together [] 🎵 Español ¿ Quién necesita libertad de expresión? [] En una notable victoria para la opresión, la Suprema Corte efectivamente puso fin a las protestas masivas en tres estados de Estados Unidos, y lo adivinaste: ¡Texas es uno de los tres! [] ¿Tener algo que decir? ¿Sientes que no te escuchan? ¿Quieres defender lo que crees que es correcto? Bueno, la Suprema Corte acaba de hacer que sea mucho más difícil expresar desacuerdo. Esto seguirá, como la mayoría de las cosas, siendo particularmente perjudicial para nuestras comunidades más marginadas. Saben que tenemos más poder colectivamente que separados, y este es otro intento de mantenernos en silos para impedir que nos organicemos. Ahora es más importante que nunca que nos aseguremos de que nuestras voces sean escuchadas. Los continuos intentos de la extrema derecha de silenciarnos continúan confirmando al menos una cosa: ven nuestro poder. Los entrenamientos SB4 "Conozca sus derechos" llegarán a Dallas y San Antonio [] La SB4 [] es una ley racista que está totalmente arraigada en la supremacía blanca. Esta ley antiinmigrante efectivamente otorgará licencia a las autoridades locales para criminalizar y encarcelar a inmigrantes negros y latinos. Ahora es más importante que nunca garantizar que todos estemos adecuadamente equipados con los conocimientos necesarios para protegernos contra esta ley peligrosa y completamente inconstitucional. Ven a defender la política de vivienda para que todos los inquilinos de Dallas obtengan la dignidad y el respeto que merecen. name: Hillsdale College via American Action News
subject: These questions are at the core of what it means to be human
body:
These questions are at the core of what it means to be human – both in our relationship with each other and with God.

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zpmq2vjcovd24099sk1a8kfsuqdhedm6p3i6rtc8_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c5j64or5c3h2bs)
---
| |
Dear Friend,

Every Hillsdale College student is required to take a class on the Western heritage in order to graduate. And every academic year, I’m reminded of the joy it is to pursue the answers to questions like “ _Does God exist? Can we know God?_ ” with my students.

These questions are at the core of what it means to be human – both in our relationship with each other and with God.
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zag86u73rinccsf1jnnuj6efhpfl8on6nkcbfloo_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c5j64or5c3h2bs) Today, I want to offer you that same experience by sending you [**a limited-edition DVD box set of Hillsdale's popular online course, “Western Heritage – From the Book of Genesis to John Locke,”**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9bg5hbceapsinjg2djn933546u9vfq9ablt9jkg_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c5j64or5c3h2bs) as a token of our thanks for a generous contribution in support of Hillsdale's efforts to educate America.

By learning about our Western roots, we add meaning and purpose to our lives and enhance our relationships with others.

I invite you to study the history of the "big questions" with my colleagues and me.

Reserve your DVD set now using this secure link: **[https://secure.hillsdale.edu/support-western-heritage-dvd](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zojnqij6nn4htrgp8tn0bbo5255qjt35p1uuc770_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c5j64or5c3h2bs)**

More than 2,000 people have already requested theirs, so make sure to get your set before they are all gone.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College

name: Christine Drazan
subject: Taxed out and priced out: Oregon families need relief
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Christine Drazan
body:
Six-figure salaries required -- to buy a home!
Friend,It's becoming increasingly clear that the American dream of owning a home is slipping out of reach for hardworking families in Oregon.According to a recent [Bankrate report,](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-xuiiyjl-dihkkhuuli-r/)_the median-priced home in the United States now stands at a staggering**$402,000.**_ Let that sink in for a moment.That's a hefty price tag, and sadly, it's not the only obstacle Oregon families face. [DEMAND RELIEF FOR OREGON FAMILIES ✍🏻](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-xuiiyjl-dihkkhuuli-y/) Thank you again for your unwavering support. Let's make Oregon proud! **Oregonians are shouldering the burden of the second-highest taxes in the nation.** This added financial strain, combined with skyrocketing housing costs, paints a bleak picture for many families. In fact, **Oregon is now among the 22 states where a six-figure income ($129,000 to be precise!), is required just to afford a home.** This is unacceptable.Hardworking Oregonians shouldn't have to break their backs and then not be able to achieve the basic American dream of homeownership. [**That's why it's crucial that we take action now. We need to cut taxes and empower Oregonians to keep more of their hard-earned dollars in their pockets, where they belong.**](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-xuiiyjl-dihkkhuuli-j/) [DEMAND RELIEF FOR OREGON FAMILIES ✍🏻](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-xuiiyjl-dihkkhuuli-t/) [**It's time to stand up for Oregon families**](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-xuiiyjl-dihkkhuuli-i/) and ensure that the path to homeownership is within reach for those who strive for it.Thank you for your support, Christine Drazan [](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-xuiiyjl-dihkkhuuli-d/)[](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-xuiiyjl-dihkkhuuli-u/)[](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-xuiiyjl-dihkkhuuli-o/) Paid for by Friends of Christine Drazan. name: Hillsdale College via Your America News
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c32273%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8OHSd%2b%2b1XFSfAQOOJha0iA&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c32274%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=oZCwr1ud39gMyzh%2bZS865Q&sysid=1)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c32274%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=oZCwr1ud39gMyzh%2bZS865Q&sysid=1)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |
---

Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we’d see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That’s why I’m asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zu31ub88hmqnn6endt3sv4mt228u5b96125d70t8_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c5j6apj2cph2bs) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer “sound learning” in order to preserve “the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty.”** Yet today’s ruling class mocks people of faith as “backward,” “bigots,” and even “Christo-fascists.” Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you “get bitter” and “cling to guns or religion.” These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today’s government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That’s why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America’s great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America’s leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include “Inside the Transgender Empire” by Christopher F. Rufo, “The Most Important Decision in Life” by Bishop Robert Barron, and “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including “The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives,” “Ancient Christianity,” and “C.S. Lewis on Christianity”) consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we’ve seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale’s educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z1h3fnricpk7het1d77qsktgari0dj8q806uhur0_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c5j6apj2cph2bs) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale’s educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. * Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That’s why I’m asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c32282%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=mei539Nx%2bn109EHj%2bi5%2bew&sysid=1) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer “sound learning” in order to preserve “the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty.”** Yet today’s ruling class mocks people of faith as “backward,” “bigots,” and even “Christo-fascists.” Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you “get bitter” and “cling to guns or religion.” These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today’s government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That’s why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America’s great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America’s leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include “Inside the Transgender Empire” by Christopher F. Rufo, “The Most Important Decision in Life” by Bishop Robert Barron, and “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including “The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives,” “Ancient Christianity,” and “C.S. Lewis on Christianity”) consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we’ve seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale’s educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c32282%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=mei539Nx%2bn109EHj%2bi5%2bew&sysid=1) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale’s educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

name: Hillsdale College via American Briefing
subject: These questions are at the core of what it means to be human
body:
These questions are at the core of what it means to be human – both in our relationship with each other and with God.

This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zr5ccai5l2o8erbot1gdvmkr9rpjuc9frlvg9g00_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c5j66oj2cph2bs)
---
| |
Dear Friend,

Every Hillsdale College student is required to take a class on the Western heritage in order to graduate. And every academic year, I’m reminded of the joy it is to pursue the answers to questions like “ _Does God exist? Can we know God?_ ” with my students.

These questions are at the core of what it means to be human – both in our relationship with each other and with God.
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zk228f3k05u86v7754o0nai6lr52tvigg5oodsj0_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c5j66oj2cph2bs) Today, I want to offer you that same experience by sending you [**a limited-edition DVD box set of Hillsdale's popular online course, “Western Heritage – From the Book of Genesis to John Locke,”**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zt0oeuk034t2526f4vbfak5rujdjtk128dc9bh3o_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c5j66oj2cph2bs) as a token of our thanks for a generous contribution in support of Hillsdale's efforts to educate America.

By learning about our Western roots, we add meaning and purpose to our lives and enhance our relationships with others.

I invite you to study the history of the "big questions" with my colleagues and me.

Reserve your DVD set now using this secure link: **[https://secure.hillsdale.edu/support-western-heritage-dvd](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zf5sn2h0798u89meuv8hrr4e2fifl2elbkn5g7u8_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c5j66oj2cph2bs)**

More than 2,000 people have already requested theirs, so make sure to get your set before they are all gone.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College

subject: Consider...
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zk7ahjgmm7mndv6f1f3o1994h6c4h09pb9qifgc8_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c5j61o34c3h2bs) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zlejp2mtgmhoupjg1vkog91randfs18lojk8jof0_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c5j61o34c3h2bs) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zeooqldj0r5mojpciof148he4rs9nahc8m390u1g_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c5j61o34c3h2bs) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| Trump Train News

---
| | Dear Fellow Conservative, On May 9th, the Ninth Circuit of Appeals will hear a groundbreaking case defending parental rights for all American mothers and fathers......against radical Leftists who want to tear children away from loving homes and brainwash them with the woke transgender agenda. **The basis of the case is California’s nefarious “Parental Secrecy Policy” – which prohibits school staff from notifying a parent when a student changes his or her “gender identity.”** If a student fails a course, skips class, or gets caught with drugs – mom or dad gets a phone call. _But if teachers decide to facilitate a gender “transition” for a child—giving a child a new name, new pronouns, and new shared facilities like locker rooms—California officials don’t think mom or dad should know._ As you can see, this is a must-win for all parents and grandparents – which is why I’m turning to freedom-loving folks like you for emergency help. **[**Will you make an emergency tax-deductible donation of $25 to help win this landmark case?**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zpv4jrbm1js3mr08lc0esmu89kcnl8vkbhm6v6r8_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c5gm8or1c9h2bs)** My name is Harmeet Dhillon and I’m the Founder and CEO of the **_Center for American Liberty_** – the conservative legal defense fund protecting _your freedom to say what you want_ , to _live according to your conscience_ , and to _pass your conservative values on to the next generation_. **Right now, we’re engaged in a huge lawsuit against a school district in California and I urgently need your help to deliver a victory for conservative parents and grandparents everywhere.** Please let me explain...Aurora Regino’s daughter was in the 5th grade in California’s Chico Unified School District when she confided her gender confusion to her guidance counselor.Without seeking professional help, providing counseling, or alerting her mother, **the guidance counselor set into motion the girl’s transition to become a “boy.”** Aurora’s daughter was given a new name, new pronouns, and a whole new identity to be used secretly at school._There wasn’t a single phone call home._ On the contrary, the guidance counselor ENCOURAGED Aurora’s daughter to keep this a secret from her mom – and instead talk to her friends and distant family members first.**Aurora was never given a chance to help her daughter. ** She was denied the opportunity to have her daughter assessed by a licensed mental health professional, consult with a trusted pediatrician, or seek counsel from a church leader.If you’re the conservative I think you are, you see the real and present danger here. **If we lose this case, for the first time in American history, schools across the country will have a green light to overturn a parent’s authority and values.** And radicals will be 100% free to use government schools – the schools you’re forced to pay for with your tax dollars – as re-education centers for every one of their twisted and anti-American ideas that go against what you and I believe. **[Now I hope you can see why I’m asking you to make an emergency tax-deductible donation of $25 to defend parental rights.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z4s1tugadmgq9n6dg4o49ft9uci1avuk2uisjvig_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c5gm8or1c9h2bs) ** If you agree parents have a fundamental right to direct the upbringing of their children, then I’m counting on you to stand with our team here at the _Center for American Liberty._ Because it’s not just the California Department of Education forcing its woke transgender agenda on students. It’s happening everywhere...
---
* **We’re suing Kaiser Permanente and the medical professionals** who coerced Chloe Cole into medically transitioning to a boy when she was 13 years old – pumping her full of life-altering hormones and drugs and amputating her two healthy breasts.
* **We’re fighting the censorship of parents in Maine** on behalf of Shawn McBreairty, who was banned for life from school property after speaking out, at a school board meeting, against sexually illicit materials and curriculum presented at his daughter’s school.
* **We sued and WON a case against another California school district** on behalf of Jessica Konen, whose 6th grade daughter was encouraged by teachers to identify as bisexual and transgender. When Jessica sounded the alarm, Child Protective Services showed up at her home – but after more than a year of litigation, Jessica and parental rights finally prevailed.

---
| | My friend, our cases CAN stop this madness.Our cases MUST stop this madness.And YOU can help us deliver these victories in the courtroom.**[Can I count on your emergency tax-deductible donation of $25 to the _Center for American Liberty_ right away?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zhio80e1c974thftdjr6ep3v14u42osbplcasc1g_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c5gm8or1c9h2bs)**Mark my words: No matter which side wins on May 9th, this case will end up at the U.S. Supreme Court.We must be prepared.The giant ACLU has already tried to throw its might behind the radicals at the Chico Unified School District. You can bet they’ll jump into the fray if this goes all the way to the highest court in the land. **[So please – whether you can help with $25, $35, $50, $100, or more – your gift is critical to help us defend parental rights from the radical Left.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2ziv0mec8pnfktssn9fhoui62ufbt2es9k9tcja20_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c5gm8or1c9h2bs)** The stakes are high, my friend. Thank you in advance for doing your part.

God Bless,

## Ohio Rejects Biden Ballot Proposal
Ohio Attorney General Dave Yost [rejected an effort by state Democrats ](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1urDAQQOGnMZ2RsQcbCoorXdFtlC4l8s94mcjrWYGzq337KKlTn-bo-7hsF0-F6vXN33BpmTcfGz1wAzlMUsMGXVoyokbT4TK4wQAYZ8ZuX7LP3mk7QZwR55BSmtSUnU4-w2ASdLRopUHBMKlptDD3yobRusk6DW62YRSgMFHjo_9kqm3HXF78wKOPfOvKsrd2P4X5J_Qq9OpDrPg8-yv_ZKHXdy7UKJ5Cr4ESVsk7sQy-FG7ywPtXKBR9lVgwNuIqOWeK5IuMXCMeFZNM6FOhikKvZ-PjJcxKSZj_g5q1NQp0dyzp_qRS6LROgLrePJXfv_an1ncAAAD__6idbFg)to circumvent a key election deadline and allow President Biden on the state's November general election ballot. Ohio election law calls for presidential candidates to be certified by their respective parties [before August 7](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGOpDAQBNCvMVkjbAyGgOAmIDnNJRfcZcjGDXhk3Mj0Dtq_X7HxRvWkSkr17zk9bYghrX_sjgMvNNmZwxsnDbIDpSdd-GFBVFgXOEgja61rUzfFNkhvOt81vu4WtSjXS-kavbha4yK1sX0RBlUpXWnZVV3T6r6sWte0pmuN0qZvXSN0hT4w5fJFIfGGS_ykN-Zypr2Iw8Z8nKL-JdQo1HhdV7mf6e6EGjHBxynUmPC646AYOMw3aQsEKx0Q0XrMJ2R84czgcac5Wz7hiDYBE6zIcGQ8g8fE8CIEdxMoQaI37g4zOBsjsVCjzfB4yPj78f9vkQd_XCHGcLZG6GrdbYjfm_nHB78CAAD__8zmc78) to appear on November's ballot. The Democratic National Convention is scheduled for August 19. A lawyer working with [Ohio Democrats sent a letter](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7Fu6yAUgOGngQ0LDgdwBoa7eMtdO1rEHBsqbCKbBuXtq3bu_A-_vo_7fA-55GP7H3byba1zWFp-0YxCjQJwRh79SgSkOXnllEbUThuePEqSIMPiHmC1ibAoe1MYHEVUQVHk2YMElKhGORqLt0Hah7FutA7Q3ezDMJQUc6vn8Fnz0RKt5V1fdA5L3XnxqbXnxfQ_BhODqfc-vEOq9acymA7qF4OpplxF2MSVvtolYu2HiLTX5QxNKKskajBySG0v_PTx2XMp-bKOodz2kMvvqv0J_w4AAP__rfRYOg) to the Ohio secretary of state last week saying the party would provisionally certify Biden before the deadline and then confirm the results at the convention later. Yost's office responded that Democrats couldn't unilaterally change election deadlines, and Ohio election laws don't allow for an alternative or provisional process.
## List: Median Income For All U.S. States

| **I Took A Pledge** Peter Willis - On Tax Day, this past Monday, April 15, I stood before the Federal Building in Lansing to sign Americans for Tax Reform’s [Taxpayer Protection Pledge](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66211d1a9a3255501bde1785&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.atr.org%2Fabout-the-pledge%2F&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_662047c228bc0338cb6fe3f7&l=en-US&s=oQB5mLlMqlpenYnc6amb0dMUKH4%3D).

---
Americans are paying too much in taxes for diminishing services, while Washington politicians keep coming up with new spending programs, driving up our national debt to $35 trillion - **$105,000 for every man, woman, and child in the country!** President Biden’s new budget has a $1.8 trillion deficit and he and **House Democrats are proposing trillions in new taxes** to pay for it.My opponent is one of the biggest tax raisers in Michigan history, including support for a 45¢ per gallon gas tax increase which would drive gas prices in Michigan over $4.35 per gallon. He was also the architect of the biggest spending bill in state history. **We simply can’t afford another big spender-big taxer in Congress.**
---
|
---
[_ _ Donate _ _](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66211d1a9a3255501bde1785&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Ftax-day&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_662047c228bc0338cb6fe3f7&l=en-US&s=3kJrH2bOveVlfaeHdIU4yLEY1jg%3D)
---
This out-of-control spending is driving up inflation and making it ever harder for families to make ends meet - let along get ahead.I hate to add to that by asking for a donation to my campaign but if we lose, you can expect even higher taxes, higher gas prices, higher grocery prices, higher insurance premiums, and worsening quality of life.I’ve pledged to fight any new taxes or new spending and when I get to Washington I will vote to cut our deficit, pay down our debt, and put America back on track.But I need you to pledge to do what you can with [a donation of $5, $10, $25, $50, $100, $250, or $500](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66211d1a9a3255501bde1785&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Ftax-day&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_662047c228bc0338cb6fe3f7&l=en-US&s=3kJrH2bOveVlfaeHdIU4yLEY1jg%3D) to help us raise the money we need to win in November.
---
|
---

name: Hillsdale College via Conservative Broadcast
subject: How important is religious liberty to you?
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from Conservative Broadcast is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Mqslfy7Zz5vDI6_vFKfxgQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRoA4bgP0SwaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtQ0ItMjAyNDA0MThXA3NwY0IKZiAJ7CBmEEgjrVIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Mqslfy7Zz5vDI6_vFKfxgQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRoA4bgP0SwaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtQ0ItMjAyNDA0MThXA3NwY0IKZiAJ7CBmEEgjrVIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Mqslfy7Zz5vDI6_vFKfxgQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRoA4bgP0SwaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtQ0ItMjAyNDA0MThXA3NwY0IKZiAJ7CBmEEgjrVIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country... Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.
Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.
The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in "extremist ideologies" and having the potential for "domestic terrorism."
Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted. **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include: **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide. After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. subject: How important is religious liberty to you?
body:
I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...

This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e9a8eb361c3e4f7db7b0f8de2108eb89&_e=yZSWqF2GUEuqhoI-zobEZ7JwZhv1sNY4UUUQgWoL7C6GO5AsSVUDa-3XFdwII68I1G5FOnasV-cjL-19doVoyg06xUs4W_-xTLonk1URjSLRJOYFXiZH0hTXS19WJxgsC5sRH3JTqZpODo4vUF7YzL9gEQQp7yXGw9MRVEokIvgvNiv6n_XyL2beM7OXGqQi4fmrSPP9QGBenkmo5CF_I3MpLpG3mb3186jiusFjDu4tj_a4cPq9C_W3vBIHTK-LDj8DtT4p00uWZV1n5ceaujyMzZVGLPr-H_j5OHfTlkLZ4qkvuQlzoTuVp2oXgSaL4zAlVN37kD_OUOzl0TrwXRZRKe-9yGDiBbaYLLeu-oYe2Sg3v4Yzp8NKcPKvQPtgvrjWTtOcQ__64C_-Yxrv_w%3D%3D) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country... Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.
Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.
The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in "extremist ideologies" and having the potential for "domestic terrorism."
Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted. **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e9a8eb361c3e4f7db7b0f8de2108eb89&_e=yZSWqF2GUEuqhoI-zobEZ7JwZhv1sNY4UUUQgWoL7C6GO5AsSVUDa-3XFdwII68I1G5FOnasV-cjL-19doVoyg06xUs4W_-xTLonk1URjSLRJOYFXiZH0hTXS19WJxgsC5sRH3JTqZpODo4vUF7YzL9gEQQp7yXGw9MRVEokIvgvNiv6n_XyL2beM7OXGqQi4fmrSPP9QGBenkmo5CF_I3MpLpG3mb3186jiusFjDu4tj_a4cPq9C_W3vBIHTK-LmLGXRWCMo6a86j9ugJUXp7uMxjt7Mw2xw9SJSnEB8SRdxWUcPQTWdw3G8gvu1fTZi93QhZYubPm_xP4ES9v180QwC27OowtptvYujeqO1K8wgnUZg5zOHJ0femvfN0X7tKnEry8DcTZQQt3nkuOJMA%3D%3D) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include: **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide. After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e9a8eb361c3e4f7db7b0f8de2108eb89&_e=yZSWqF2GUEuqhoI-zobEZ7JwZhv1sNY4UUUQgWoL7C6GO5AsSVUDa-3XFdwII68I1G5FOnasV-cjL-19doVoyg06xUs4W_-xTLonk1URjSLRJOYFXiZH0hTXS19WJxgsC5sRH3JTqZpODo4vUF7YzL9gEQQp7yXGw9MRVEokIvgvNiv6n_XyL2beM7OXGqQi4fmrSPP9QGBenkmo5CF_I3MpLpG3mb3186jiusFjDu4tj_a4cPq9C_W3vBIHTK-LEaKjGU8E_ny6boE3HezQzQB1MfbPsX5Bn2G23zMR2sXkuvx95lg6uHILrNrF0jOs4yihWk8vpUdbib91VSp7_ss3LvZO05aq372KYUkc9hxnfeowg9z1H4kGbDvdNYI6UK8ZwEOL0RRjOpQA60cBkQ%3D%3D) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

name: Colonel Mark Robertson
subject: Reminder: Review Journal Q&As
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Robertson for Congress](https://dwhdqsbbb
body:
Here is a preview of the Q&A in the upcoming Voters' Guide
| | | |
---

---
Hello Peter,
Recently the Las Vegas Review-Journal newspaper asked me three questions. They will include my responses in their Voters' Guide. I was endorsed by the Review-Journal during the last election. Here is a preview of the questions and answers.....
Mark Robertson
1. What would be your top three priorities, if elected, and what specific actions will you take to get them done? (100 word limit) 1. Sponsor legislation to secure our border to stop the flow of guns, gangs, and drugs into our communities, followed by immigration reform that only allows people into our country with the skills we need and who will not require government assistance. 2. Fight to return regular order to our budgeting process, thus controlling spending on our way to a balanced budget. 3. Introduce legislation to protect parents' right to choose which school is best for their child while reducing or eliminating the federal government's role in education. Education funds should follow the child.
2\. What sets you apart from the other candidates? Why should Republican voters pick you? (100 word limit) I have strong ties to our community. I owned a business here and freely give time to community organizations, our church, and local Veteran groups. I served in the Army for 30 years, deploying to ten foreign countries, including combat tours in Afghanistan, Kuwait, and Iraq. I am best positioned to defeat Dina Titus. I received more votes than any other candidate who has faced Titus. In 2022, I beat Titus in Henderson and Boulder City, and by 20 points with in-person voters. My campaign has hundreds of volunteers, thousands of followers, and over 100,000 people who voted for me.
3\. How will you appeal to Nevada's nonpartisan voters? (100 word limit) For the past 32 years, I have worked, played, served, and worshipped with the people in my district regardless of any party affiliation. They know me, and I know them. Through my work with nonprofit organizations such as Opportunity Village, the Salvation Army, and Veteran groups, I have formed friendships with people of all races, religions, national origins, and economic statuses. As a Certified Financial Planner, I worked with teachers, first responders, hotel service workers, blue-collar workers, and people from all walks of life. As a Congressman, I will be loyal to the Constitution and the people of my district.

*************************************************************************************************

Here are eight great and simple ways to support Mark.
1. Tell others about Mark. This can be done face-to-face, over the phone, via email or text, on social media, or any other method. Encourage people to vote for Mark early, in person or by mail.
2. Follow Mark on Facebook. Click here to go to our campaign page: [Facebook](https://dwhdqsbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001jS8qQhloSZTjRuNYLmxw2WeyiAiMOG_WiOdOPDTSj6OmaNSpG9mDpIXFCpWaHVn6IpyTQRYFpMlwhCuXRMAly2SMLzdjDwCEvwssmLAaNBCukzhPtGe51RytRK-lcR20Z9ufCix3TJIvQ9bqfT1yr3ASW6XBaBbNT7n1QmhDZLc=&c=RUZ1a3f0KlOx978QNz1EAy6T82CNCCFWi05A-eSAkUurrdu00McnbQ==&ch=2mnywwiQNBQypWs0jerjVD3NHUrvTqiwPWU-5rm6Ou1Y-brul9GZsg==). When you like a post, you can share it with others by simply hitting the "share" button.

body:
Hey All - for anyone local or willing to head this way - I would really
appreciate your help this weekend! We're going to be knocking doors in
Noblesville and Cicero and it's coming down to the wire!

Take a look at the info below and let me know if you're able to head out!

Thank you,
Max Engling

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Jacob Thifault <jacob@maxforindiana.com>
Date: Mon, Apr 15, 2024 at 4:39 PM
Subject: Door knock with Max this Saturday! ITS CRUNCH TIME!
Cc: Max Engling <max4@maxforindiana.com>

Thank you for your willingness to support/volunteer for Max Engling as he
works to win on May 7th – now in the homestretch we need your help getting
the message out to voters!

Join us this Saturday as we canvas in Noblesville and Cicero. It’s a great
time together and an opportunity to help get Max across the finish
line. Head over, get a shirt, and spread the message!

*Before you Knock*

*1. *RSVP with your first, last name, and shirt size (reply all to this
email) – anyone is welcome – bring a friend!

*2. *Download the *Numinar* App from the App Store.

*MORNING** Door Knocking (Noblesville)*

*Date*: Saturday, April 20, 2024

*Meet-up Location*: Freedom Church parking lot (1361 Christian Ave
Noblesville, IN)

*Time*: *9:30AM - Donuts and Door Knocking *
