# TODAY'S TOP STORIES
---
[**Plan to quadruple property taxes on short-term rentals fails in late-night Capitol committee vote**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
| [ ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
A bill that would have[ quadrupled the property taxes](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) on many homes offered as short-term rentals in Colorado was rejected late Tuesday in a Colorado Senate committee, marking at least the third time in recent years that such a proposal has failed at the Capitol. [Senate Bill 33](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) was voted down 6-1 by the Senate Finance Committee during the bill’s first hearing, an outcome that came after months of [loud opposition](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) from vacation rental owners and companies like Airbnb and Vrbo. The only “yes” vote on the measure came from its main sponsor, [Sen. Chris Hansen](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), a Denver Democrat. **[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**

[**Andrews, Webb qualify for ballot in crowded 3rd District primary field for Boebert’s seat in Congress**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The 3rd District's Republican primary election to nominate a candidate for Congress is becoming more crowded, with [Russ Andrews and Lew Webb joining the list](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) of hopefuls.

* Rep. Lauren Boebert, the current representative, is [relocating to the 4th District](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), leaving an open seat in the 3rd District. Stephen Varela, Ron Hanks, Curtis McCrackin, and Jeff Hurd had already [secured a place](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) on the Republican ballot through various means.

* Andrews and Webb qualified for the ballot by [submitting signatures](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), with Andrews garnering 2,224 accepted signatures out of 3,931 submitted, and Webb receiving 1,784 accepted signatures out of 3,199 submitted. Joe Granado has also submitted a petition for a place on the ballot, but the Secretary of State's office has not yet announced a decision on its qualification.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**Colorado congressional candidates report contributions, cash in bank ahead of crowded primaries**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Democrat Adam Frisch continues to[ lead in fundraising](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) among Colorado's congressional candidates, as he has throughout this election cycle. Frisch raised [$1.4 million in contributions for the first quarter of the year](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), making him the only federal candidate in the state to surpass seven figures in fundraising for the fifth consecutive reporting period.

* Despite losing U.S. Rep. Lauren Boebert as an opponent, Frisch maintains strong fundraising momentum. Frisch [nearly unseated Boebert](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in the Republican-leaning 3rd Congressional District in 2022, and his fundraising success underscores his continued viability as a candidate.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**Trump rakes in over $1M in small donations after first day in New York hush money trial**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[THE WASHINGTON TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Former President Donald Trump [raised over $1 million in campaign funds](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) following the first day of his New York hush-money trial.

* Lara Trump, his daughter-in-law and co-chair of the Republican National Committee, highlighted the support for Trump, noting that the [average donation was $28](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

* The trial, brought by Manhattan District Attorney Alvin Bragg, centers on [34 counts of falsifying business records](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) related to hush-money payments made to Stormy Daniels by Trump's former lawyer, Michael Cohen. Trump's legal team contends that the payments were legitimate legal expenses, not part of a cover-up, and denies any inappropriate relationship with Daniels.

* [Jury selection](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) dominated the proceedings on Monday and Tuesday, with the process expected to last up to two weeks to select 12 jurors and six alternatives from a pool of over 500 people.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**COMMENTARY: Colorado legislature is the real threat to democracy**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
BY JON CALDARA, [COMPLETE COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _Every conversation about the Colorado state legislature should begin with this preface: “And these are the people who say Donald Trump is a threat to democracy. ...”_ _The legislature is moving forward with a bill to rip away direct elections of the Regional Transportation District Board (RTD), which encompasses the largest population of any local government in the state._ _Yes, they are willing to allow a couple of “window dressing” elected seats to “represent” the 3 million suckers in the Denver metro area, while minion political appointees seize control of the state’s largest local government. But the goal is clear: end taxation with representation._ _And these are the people who say Donald Trump is a threat to democracy._ [**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)

Hi Friend Unknown,
We’re less than one week away from the Presidential Primary Election on Tuesday, April 23 in the Commonwealth. In this week’s roundup, we’ve compiled resources, upcoming events, important dates, and news you can use to stay informed, and ready to VOTE!
|
---
# 2024 Important Primary Election Dates
**April 8:** Last day to register to vote in the primary election [vote.pa.gov/register](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=d231109ec6&e=95417d7e87)**April 16:** Last day to apply for a mail ballot [vote.pa.gov/applymailballot](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=7a317359db&e=95417d7e87) **April 23** : Completed mail ballots must be received by 8:00 p.m. [vote.pa.gov/county](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=fc49a2970f&e=95417d7e87)**April 23:** Election Day. Polls are open 7:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m.[vote.pa.gov/polls](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=4005a1c550&e=95417d7e87)
**Reminder:** Your ballot must be **RECEIVED** by your county’s election office by Tuesday, April 23, 2024 by 8 p.m. We recommend returning it by hand to your local election office as soon as possible to avoid any delays!
# We’re Hiring!
The New Pennsylvania Project is currently hiring! Please see our open positions below:
* [Director of Strategic Communications](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=533d19c4f9&e=95417d7e87)
* [Regional Organizing Director: Chester & Delaware Counties](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=55152ec026&e=95417d7e87)
* [Regional Organizing Director: Bucks County](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=e305f35c86&e=95417d7e87)
* [Regional Organizing Director: Philadelphia](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=8e06eb848f&e=95417d7e87)
* [Community Engagement Associates (Lehigh Valley and Chester/Delaware Counties)](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=113a36c013&e=95417d7e87)
* [Part-time Education & Engagement Associates (Lehigh Valley and Chester/Delaware Counties) via affiliated organization New PA Project Education Fund](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=d0bc4d6502&e=95417d7e87)

Interested in joining Team NPP? Please email your resume to [jobs@newpaproject.org](mailto:jobs@newpaproject.org) and provide the position you are applying for in the subject line.

# NPP In The News
Khalif Ali, director of the voting rights organization New Pennsylvania Project, said that Americans ‘cannot turn a blind eye’ to the threats facing the country’s democratic institutions and practices. Read the full story and Khalif’s commentary [here](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=6f89200977&e=95417d7e87).
# Social of the Week

---|---|---
|
---
# Upcoming Events
Join Northampton Community College Student Life on Thursday, April 18 for a nonpartisan panel on the current state of U.S. Democracy before we head into the April 23rd primary election. Kadida Kenner, CEO of New Pennsylvania Project will be a featured panelist. **Date** : Thursday, April 18, 2024
**Time** : 11:00 a.m.
**Where** : Northampton Community College, 3835 Green Pond Road, Bethlehem PA 18020
Save the date and make sure you join us in Harrisburg and Philadelphia for _**We Fight Back!**_ , an event co-sponsored by the aligned organization, New PA Project Education Fund. There will be free food, Black Voters Matter merch, music, and more!
**GOTV Food Drive****Date:** April 21, 2024**Time:** 1:00 - 3:00 p.m. ET**Location:** 4635 Frankford Avenue, Philadelphia, PA
**Harrisburg GOTV Community Event****Date:** April 21, 2024**Time:** 4:30 - 7:00 p.m. ET**Location:** 250 Riley St., Harrisburg, PA
|
---
# News You Can Use
**Divided U.S. Supreme Court wrestles with case of Pennsylvania man who joined Jan. 6 mob** The U.S. Supreme Court heard arguments Tuesday in a Jan. 6, 2021, case that could potentially upend convictions for a mass of Capitol riot defendants and slash some election interference charges against former President Donald Trump, [Penn Capital Star](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=c8ec83fb9e&e=95417d7e87) reports.
**How to Track Your Pennsylvania Mail Ballot** Ballots must be returned to county election offices by 8 p.m. on Election Day on April 23 in order to be counted, [The Philadelphia Inquirer](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=30270c0ca0&e=95417d7e87) reports.
**PA Primary Preview: Democrats For Attorney General** Five candidates are vying for the Democratic nomination for Attorney General. The position has been viewed recently as a stepping stone to the Governor’s mansion, as both Josh Shapiro and Tom Corbett served as AG prior to assuming the executive position, [PoliticsPA](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=f6d8238358&e=95417d7e87) reports.
**PA Primary Preview: Republicans For Attorney General.** Two candidates are vying for the Republican nomination for Attorney General. The position has been viewed recently as a stepping stone to the Governor’s mansion, as both Josh Shapiro and Tom Corbett served as AG prior to assuming the executive position, [PoliticsPA](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=0faeb36ed3&e=95417d7e87) reports.
**Philly Sees 37% Drop in Homicides** The number of homicides in major American cities is falling at its quickest pace in decades following huge jumps during the pandemic, Axios' Russell Contreras [writes](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=521dbeffef&e=95417d7e87).Why It Matters: The nation is on track to see one of the lowest levels of violent crimes and homicides since President Obama was in office. Polls show crime is a top concern ahead of the 2024 election — and it's an issue where Republicans regularly edge Democrats.
**Pennsylvania’s Top Election Official Begins Daily Election Updates Ahead Of Primary** Secretary of the Commonwealth Al Schmidt on Monday held the first of several planned informational live streams that will be held daily leading up to the April 23 primary elections. The goal, Schmidt said, is to ensure transparency, [Penn Capital-Star](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=1a18000ff9&e=95417d7e87) reports.
**Republican Voter Registration Is Booming in Pennsylvania** In every single county in Pennsylvania, the number of registered Republicans has increased in the last five months. And in all but a handful, the number of Democrats has declined, [NOTUS](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=4cc3235a53&e=95417d7e87) reports.
**Congressional Primary Preview: PA-10** In their continuing series, [PoliticsPA](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=9d71d5bccc&e=95417d7e87) takes a look at the Democratic contenders for the 10th Congressional District nomination for the U.S. House of Representatives.
**Pa. Democrats and union workers rally at the Capitol for $20 per hour ‘living wage’** All of Pennsylvania’s neighboring states have a higher minimum wage, but the Keystone State remains stuck at the federal minimum of $7.25 an hour, [Penn Capital Star](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=3e591116f4&e=95417d7e87) reports.
|

# Help Us Expand The Electorate
**We're on a mission to register new voters in the Commonwealth and expand the electorate.**
**Help us prepare for the upcoming primary and general elections in 2024!**
[](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=c2db4cdea3&e=95417d7e87)
The 2024 General Election is just around the corner but there is much work to be done — and we can’t do it alone! New Pennsylvania Project is on a mission to register 60,000 voters from across the Commonwealth, with a focus on reaching those from underserved and underrepresented communities. We can’t do that, however, without your continued support. If you haven’t yet, please consider clicking the button below and investing just a few dollars in these efforts.
Every dollar helps us host more events, reach more people, and ultimately, register more voters ahead of this incredibly high-stakes election!

| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE THURSDAY, APRIL 18
PHOTO RELEASE: GREATER GEORGIA HOSTS SECOND ANNUAL LEGISLATIVE AWARDS CEREMONY (ATLANTA) - This week, Greater Georgia hosted the second annual Greater Georgia Legislative Awards Ceremony. Held in Atlanta, the event drew over 300 guests to honor state lawmakers and leaders for their accomplishments during the 2024 legislative session. Honored guest speakers included Governor Brian P. Kemp, First Lady Marty Kemp, and Speaker of the House Jon Burns.
Award recipients from the Georgia General Assembly included:
State Senate Majority Leader Steve Gooch Majority Whip Randy Robertson Majority Caucus Secretary Larry Walker Senator Greg Dolezal Senator Russ Goodman
State House Representative Lauren Daniel Representative Matthew Gambill Representative John LaHood Representative Mesha Mainor Representative Steven Sainz

subject: What Happened in the General Assembly Yesterday?

body:
Legislators Met in Richmond
| | | |
VIRGINIA GENERAL ASSEMBLY SPECIAL SESSION CALLED
MONDAY, MAY 13

---
---
| Friends, Legislators returned to Richmond yesterday for Reconvene, also called Veto Session. The session lasted one day for about 5 hours. Legislators gaveled in at 12:30pm and adjourned at 5:30pm to accept or reject Governor Youngkin's amendments to their bills, which included the budget.
The Democrats only have a one member majority in each house, so thankfully they were unable to override any of the Governor's 153 vetoes. That's the good news.
Legislators completed all of their work with the exception of the budget, which is a monumental task in an of itself. During both regular session and reconvene, no deal was made between Governor Youngkin and Democrat controlled House and Senate leadership.
A press conference was held at the Capitol yesterday, in which all parties said they were going to start from scratch and work together to come up with a budget. Unlike the federal government, by law Virginia must balance their budget, which is supposed to go into effect July 1, 2024.
Governor Youngkin has called for a Special Session on Monday, May 13 for the sole purpose of working on the budget. Legislators will most likely vote on the budget on Wednesday, May 15, after the 48 hour review legal requirement so that legislators can carefully review the budget.
The Democrat controlled legislature did take up many of Governor Youngkin's amendments in a block to veto his suggestions.
Some Democrat legislators accepted the governor's amendments and their bills will likely be signed into law. The legislators who didn't accept the governor's amendments know that their bill will die. Some Democrat legislators chose to pass their bills by for the day, which essentially kills the bill, in lieu of having the governor veto their bill.
There is still a battle over the budget. The Democrat controlled legislature wants to increase taxes on every Virginian. Governor Youngkin is opposing and vetoing legislation that would raise taxes on every Virginian.
Here is the final list of bills Governor Youngkin has vetoed or amended. If you want more detail about a particular bill, just click on the tab for veto, sign or amend.
If you missed watching the House and Senate reconvene session yesterday, you can watch the recording by clicking the links below to each house.
Included in this weekly newsletter is a list of important dates for upcoming primaries and elections. Please mark your calendar.
---
|
---
Please also consider following me on [Facebook at Amanda Chase Virginia Senator](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001n-pc3ID-_1eauZzcPN_OCxYMKo6spoCgTxoP85GeLy0nSNs3eEpl5ywwae3Y5-ofr4FUkThCI0aXgOgjbN3guMD_LvsRXPgo7_gxlVHnLFHTou0EqtFoujG77w0crvkIn9ZO_k-cysXmcJgR7laukL3i3yMzAMbKlew5KS9V02pBq4sFFoEpEq6hPF95qLRJCcdMRdDgDnA=&c=TBHhUtQv10dMBb5UlvnGXTv-FJwnomvFZ0rEGlmLo1KEoc4ebhnpNQ==&ch=eNIbHWE29Goe3DZYSC_wu72HBA3U2mHOW2yz1oC_OQHxdtik_JucIA==) for my real time daily posts regarding votes on controversial and significant impact bills.
Hope you find my daily and weekly newsletter along with my Facebook posts helpful in following the General Assembly.
Hope you will tune in today at noon on Monday, May 13 to watch your General Assembly take up the budget.
Will Virginians be taxed more by the Democrat controlled General Assembly or will Governor Youngkin continue to push back and win for Virginians who are taxed enough already?

# Governor's Budget Amendments
---
|
* Governor Youngkin has proposed a grand total of 242 amendments to budget bills HB 29 and HB 30. He wants to "preserve the vast majority of spending priorities as passed by the General Assembly."

* Governor Youngkin supports his $64 billion Common Ground Budget which eliminates all proposed tax increases, invests a record $21.2 billion in K-12 education, caps tuition increases at 3%, includes 3% pay raises for teachers and state employees in each year, and increases investments in health and human resources by $3.2 billion over the biennium.

* The budget passed by the Democrat controlled General Assembly eliminated over $850 million of the Governor's priority spending items in the introduced budget and $1 billion of tax relief; the Common Ground budget restores only $230 million of those priorities.

* The Governor's Common Ground budget includes $196 million in additional funding for at-risk students, an additional $1 billion in higher education funding, $175 million for the Housing Trust Fund, toll relief in Hampton Roads, a full funding of the state's share of WMATA's short-term funding needs, and $70 million to expedite projects on Interstate-81.

* Our reserve fund balances are among the best of any state in the nation. We have over $4.6 billion in reserve funds representing 15% of our annual general fund spending. Revenue collections are running ahead of the revenue forecast by $827 million year to date.

* In short, Virginia can fund priorities and maintain our long-term structural balance without raising taxes. The Governor proposed 1 billion in tax relief in his introduced budget, while the budget passed by the General Assembly included tax increases that would cost Virginians $2.6 billion in total. The Governor claims the Common Ground budget allows us to write a clean budget without tax increases or tax decreases.

clean_body: Legislators Met in Richmond | | | | VIRGINIA GENERAL ASSEMBLY SPECIAL SESSION CALLED MONDAY, MAY 13 | Friends, Legislators returned to Richmond yesterday for Reconvene, also called Veto Session. The session lasted one day for about 5 hours. Legislators gaveled in at 12:30pm and adjourned at 5:30pm to accept or reject Governor Youngkin's amendments to their bills, which included the budget. The Democrats only have a one member majority in each house, so thankfully they were unable to override any of the Governor's 153 vetoes. That's the good news. Legislators completed all of their work with the exception of the budget, which is a monumental task in an of itself. During both regular session and reconvene, no deal was made between Governor Youngkin and Democrat controlled House and Senate leadership. A press conference was held at the Capitol yesterday, in which all parties said they were going to start from scratch and work together to come up with a budget. Unlike the federal government, by law Virginia must balance their budget, which is supposed to go into effect July 1, 2024. Governor Youngkin has called for a Special Session on Monday, May 13 for the sole purpose of working on the budget. Legislators will most likely vote on the budget on Wednesday, May 15, after the 48 hour review legal requirement so that legislators can carefully review the budget. The Democrat controlled legislature did take up many of Governor Youngkin's amendments in a block to veto his suggestions. Some Democrat legislators accepted the governor's amendments and their bills will likely be signed into law. The legislators who didn't accept the governor's amendments know that their bill will die. Some Democrat legislators chose to pass their bills by for the day, which essentially kills the bill, in lieu of having the governor veto their bill. There is still a battle over the budget. The Democrat controlled legislature wants to increase taxes on every Virginian. Governor Youngkin is opposing and vetoing legislation that would raise taxes on every Virginian. Here is the final list of bills Governor Youngkin has vetoed or amended. If you want more detail about a particular bill, just click on the tab for veto, sign or amend. If you missed watching the House and Senate reconvene session yesterday, you can watch the recording by clicking the links below to each house. Included in this weekly newsletter is a list of important dates for upcoming primaries and elections. Please mark your calendar. | Please also consider following me on == for my real time daily posts regarding votes on controversial and significant impact bills. Hope you find my daily and weekly newsletter along with my Facebook posts helpful in following the General Assembly. Hope you will tune in today at noon on Monday, May 13 to watch your General Assembly take up the budget. Will Virginians be taxed more by the Democrat controlled General Assembly or will Governor Youngkin continue to push back and win for Virginians who are taxed enough already? body: 96https://secure.winred.com/reddy-for-kansas-03/unique-story-email-fundr aising?utm_source=rc&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024april17hf When it comes to this campaign for Congress, I’m all-in. I’ve taken a step back from my career to focus 100% of my time on it. This seat, and our country, are worth fighting for. I never wanted to run for office, but I refuse to sit by and watch Republicans lose another winnable race. My life story has brought me to this point. My family came to America from Chennai, India, on the promise of the American Dream. We arrived in Kansas when I was still a child. https://secure.winred.com/reddy-for-kansas-03/unique-story-email-fundrai sing?utm_source=rc&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024april17hf I was raised in Kansas, graduated from public schools in Kansas, and set out to live my American Dream. For me, that meant a bachelor’s degree from Kansas State, a medical degree from the University of Kansas Medical Center, and a career in medicine. https://secure.winred.com/reddy-for-kansas-03/unique-story-email-fundrai sing?utm_source=rc&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024april17hf American citizenship is the privilege of a lifetime, and I’ve worked every day to make the most of it. I practiced medicine for more than a decade before moving to research. When the unthinkable occurred on 9/11, my life changed. I became a citizen, enlisted in the U.S. Air Force Reserve, and am proud to serve as a Lieutenant Colonel today. https://secure.winred.com/reddy-for-kansas-03/unique-story-email-fundrai sing?utm_source=rc&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024april17hf I’m a cancer physician, a military officer, and an immigrant. I’ve spent my career running towards, and solving, complex problems. That’s what we need now, not more talk from the politicians who’ve made every single problem we face even worse. That’s been my message from the start, and the folks I’ve talked to across the district agree. Sharice Davids just isn’t getting the job done. It’s time for new leadership, and I’m the Republican who can unite our party and flip this seat. https://secure.winred.com/reddy-for-kansas-03/unique-story-email-fundrai sing?utm_source=rc&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024april17hf With Democrats already announcing huge ad buys against me, and Sharice Davids having millions in the bank, it’s critical we have the means to respond to attacks, share my story, and build a campaign that can win. https://secure.winred.com/reddy-for-kansas-03/unique-story-email-fundrai sing?utm_source=rc&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024april17hf That’s why I’m asking you, if you’re ready for someone different in Congress, to pitch in *any amount* here. Every single donation helps me share my life story and message, and it helps our team invest in printing campaign materials, running ads, and turning out voters. Let’s win this!   https://secure.winred.com/reddy-for-kansas-03/unique-story-email-fundrai sing?utm_source=rc&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024april17hf Dr. Prasanth Reddy https://secure.winred.com/reddy-for-kansas-03/unique-story-email-fundrai sing?utm_source=rc&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024april17hf CHIP IN NOW    https://secure.winred.com/reddy-for-kansas-03/hf-fo oter-email?utm_source=rc&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024april17hf Meet Dr. Prasanth Reddy: Dr. Reddy is a cancer physician and immigrant who's lived the American Dream. In the aftermath of 9/11, he answered his country's call. He became a citizen, joined the U.S. Air Force Reserve, and still serves as Lt. Colonel today. Dr. Reddy is running for Congress against a Democrat who votes with Joe Biden 100% of the time, in one of the most competitive House districts in the country. A little over a week after Tim Ozinga’s shock resignation (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/bombshell-resignation-rocks-illinois-gop-tim-ozinga-vacates-office-effective-immediately.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=404aab8d25-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) from the Illinois House of Representatives, the landscape of the Illinois Republican Party underwent a dramatic transformation during Wednesday night’s Will County GOP Convention after Christina Clausen secured her position as the new chairwoman of the Will County Republican Central Committee, garnering an impressive 12,220 votes to her opponent’s 6,234 – leaving Ozinga and his allies in shock and disbelief.

Clausen’s victory signals a significant shift towards a staunchly conservative agenda. An ardent America First patriot, Clausen has been embraced by the party’s conservative base for her dedication to nationalist principles and her clear commitment to the conservative cause. The overwhelming support reflects a clear preference among party members for leadership that embodies former President Donald Trump’s ideologies and policies.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/tim-ozinga-suffers-humiliating-defeat-as-conservative-christina-clausen-dominates-will-county-gop-chairman-race.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=404aab8d25-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

In another key development at the convention, Hillary Kurzawa was elected as the new secretary, taking over from Raquel Mitchell who declined the nomination. Kurzawa’s appointment further consolidates the shift towards a more conservative platform within the committee. These changes at the top echelons of the Will County Republican Central Committee occurred against the backdrop of Tim Ozinga’s controversial tenure and subsequent resignation as a state representative.

Want to know why I got into politics, friend? **It's because I wanted to shine a light on the issues that mattered most to working families like mine.**
I grew up as the granddaughter of immigrants and the daughter of a World War II veteran. From an early age, my family ingrained in me the value of hard work, showed me how unions built the middle class, and instilled in me the belief that every worker deserves the right to bargain for better pay and benefits, a safe workplace, and a dignified retirement.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83243070/467773809/2034486384?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk3709-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YjU5ODE2MC04NmZkLWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=S0Eo40CT4Z74hYRBl1FF6d9jmNPz4vFTqYhOKgtpZA4=)
My grandmother worked the graveyard shift at the Nabisco cookie factory nearly her entire adult life – and she was able to retire with dignity because she was a member of the Bakery and Confectionery Workers' union (the sweetest union). My uncles were firefighters whose union made sure they had the security of decent pay and workplace protections. I worked myself as a cocktail waitress at Caesars Palace to help pay my way through college, and I was a proud card-carrying member of the Culinary Workers Union Local 226 in Las Vegas.
That's who I am and where I come from – and that’s why I've always fought for issues like strengthening workers’ rights to unionize, securing paid family leave, raising the minimum wage, and lowering everyday costs for families. **But to keep up my fight for working families, I need your urgent help.**
**Mitch McConnell personally recruited a far-right, anti-union candidate to defeat me, and then a MAGA billionaire and shady dark money groups started pouring millions into Nevada to prop up his campaign. Now, polling shows me locked in a dead heat — in the race that experts say will likely decide Senate control.**

I grew up as the granddaughter of immigrants and the daughter of a World War II veteran. You and I both know how rare it is for a celebrity in Hollywood to support conservative candidates for federal office - it’s even more rare for them to offer their support publicly. But quite frankly, I couldn’t care less about winning the support of Hollywood actors, directors, or anyone involved with the entertainment industry. My opponent, on the other hand, is actively soliciting their financial support. I have received emails from actress Glenn Close on two occasions. In her fundraising appeals on behalf of Jon Tester’s campaign, she writes, “Jon Tester is running for reelection in Montana—it’s the most important race on the map. This election will determine the future of our country, and I can’t sit on the sidelines with stakes as high as these.” Please consider a contribution to my campaign today. Is it the Hollywood, coastal California elite, or the people of Montana who sent him to Washington to be their voice? With A-LIST Hollywood celebrities on his team, there is no telling the amount of resources Tester will be able to marshal over the next seven months. I appreciate your help with this matter. name: Adam Schiff
subject: At my wit’s end
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
| After a federal judge ruled that DeJoy’s changes to the U.S. Postal Service before the 2020 election harmed mail delivery and impeded voting by mail at the height of the pandemic, DeJoy’s sabotage of the USPS may spill into another presidential election.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=6250%2E5257348%2E9vxCXP)
Derek, I’m at my wit’s end after reading _another_ report ringing the alarm on Trump mega-donor and Postmaster General Louis DeJoy’s destructive actions concerning the U.S. Postal Service. _We can’t stand for this._
**A federal judge ruled that DeJoy’s changes to the U.S. Postal Service before the 2020 election harmed mail delivery and impeded voting by mail at the height of the pandemic. Now, DeJoy’s actions undermining the USPS may spill into _another_ presidential election.**
[](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-20240418-dejoy-petition.y35a8u&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20240418_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=6250%2E5257348%2E9vxCXP)
If you are wondering how Donald Trump’s handpicked Postmaster General... a former RNC finance chair who has donated millions to Republican candidates... whose family is a major investor in a company that _directly competes with the USPS_ ... who used his taxpayer-funded position to award that very company a $120 million USPS contract with taxpayer dollars... who was the subject of an FBI investigation of an alleged straw donor scheme to support GOP candidates... who removed mail ballot drop boxes and fought to decommission hundreds of mail sorting facilities during the 2020 election, backing down only after the American Postal Workers Union filed an official grievance... whose general counsel strong-armed states and threatened that if they did not pay first class postage on ballots that they may not arrive in time to vote by mail... AND whose 10-year austerity plan is on track to close 400 mail sorting facilities across the country... if you are wondering how _this_ person still somehow remains at the helm of leadership of the Postal Service, **I will explain:**
The Postmaster General is not subject to Senate confirmation like presidential Cabinet nominees. Instead, they are appointed by the USPS’ Board of Governors, who _are_ subject to Senate approval.
**Right now, the Board of Governors has a pro-DeJoy majority, with multiple members nominated by Donald Trump, and two vacancies for which President Biden has yet to name his nominees — vacancies that have remained open for _months._**
[**We are running out of the precious little time we have remaining to replace the dangerously destructive presence of Louis DeJoy at USPS — before his mismanagement interferes with another presidential election. Please, join me in urging President Biden to send his Board of Governors nominations to the Senate so they can be confirmed with extreme haste. Add your name to my petition today:**](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-20240418-dejoy-petition.y35a8u&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20240418_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=5&akid=6250%2E5257348%2E9vxCXP)
[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-20240418-dejoy-petition.y35a8u&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20240418_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=6&akid=6250%2E5257348%2E9vxCXP)
---
If you are alarmed by the idea of a Trump-appointed former RNC money man, who has enriched himself at the taxpayers’ expense, been the subject of FBI investigations, and found culpable by a federal judge of harming voting in the 2020 election, administering _another_ election in which the guy who gave him the job and incited a violent insurrection when he lost is running again as the challenger, you’re not alone.
Louis DeJoy has got to go. Thanks for joining me in making this urgent request for President Biden to act.
— Adam

The politically-driven prosecution of Donald Trump in New York is unprecedented and is truly an abomination under the law. And it's hard to believe that the Left's corruption and weaponization of government in their relentless drive to destroy Donald Trump and re-elect Joe Biden will lead to anything other than a further decline in respect for the rule of law by many Americans who already believe that our legal and justice systems are being swallowed up by politics and partisanship.

| Dear Fellow American,

The politically-driven prosecution of Donald Trump in New York is unprecedented and is truly an abomination under the law.
And it's hard to believe that the Left's corruption and weaponization of government in their relentless drive to destroy Donald Trump and re-elect Joe Biden will lead to anything other than a _further decline_ in respect for the rule of law by many Americans who already believe that our legal and justice systems are being swallowed up by politics and partisanship.
That is why, while many conservatives _complain_ about Trump's treatment in New York and by the corrupt Biden Justice Department, [_Judicial Watch acts...and it's why I hope you will join with us today!_](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=67946&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)!

Since then, we have filed no fewer than **TEN** state and federal lawsuits related to the harassment and prosecution of Trump, and we have also filed no fewer than **FIFTEEN** state and federal open records law requests to get to the facts about the various state and federal lawsuits designed to cripple and eliminate Trump as an opponent and rig Biden's re-election.

And we have also blazed a path in the courts exposing the politically-driven failure of government agencies, like the FBI and the Justice Department, to mount serious investigations into credible allegations of Biden family corruption, as well as their habitual refusal to release public documents to Judicial Watch's lawful Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) requests.

Hi friend,
The recount for California’s 16th District is officially underway.
It’s a process we didn’t call for, and that wasn’t needed, but we’re heartened by the coalition of supporters standing strong behind our campaign.
As a reminder, our campaign did NOT call for this recount, but we’ll still have to pay for legal representation to defend ourselves in the recount process.
Given the circumstances, we’re so glad to have strong California leaders like Congressman Ro Khanna and California Labor Federation leader Lorena Gonzalez on our side. Just take a look at what they have to say:

**I put a bullet through Osama bin Laden's skull, Friend. **

It's Rob O'Neill. I'm a Navy SEAL. At my core, I am built to serve this country; I will do _**WHATEVER**_ it takes to make America safe and prosperous.

I hope you share that sentiment. And if you don't, then the rest of this message just isn't for you. Feel free to delete this email and move on with your life if you're not committed to American excellence.

name: Eric Hansen, candidate for U.S. Senate
subject: 11 pounds of fentanyl
body:
(Everyone in Delaware is dead...) | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/20e9e58ff89e/im-running-for-us-senate-14158209?e=dbd1068b05)
---

In February of this year, a drug sweep [resulted](https://voteerichansen.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=507adf5d727e502cde205c852&id=41f26ab70a&e=dbd1068b05) in the seizure of 11 pounds of fentanyl in a Philadelphia neighborhood - enough to kill every man, woman and child in Delaware two and a half time times.
In January, almost 400,000 doses of fentanyl, heroin and other drugs worth about $3.6 million were seized by authorities - also in Philadelphia. The criminals [were charged](https://voteerichansen.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=507adf5d727e502cde205c852&id=e3d0c337c2&e=dbd1068b05) with running a widespread drug trafficking ring throughout southeastern Pennsylvania.
I don’t know about you, but these two recent examples hit a little too close to home for me. Fentanyl trafficking doesn’t stop at state lines. What happens in Philly can easily happen in Dover - or any other Delaware town.
**It has to end, and pretending like we don’t know the root cause of the fentanyl crisis in America is doing a great disservice to the people of our state.**
The drug epidemic here in Delaware is real. You know it. I know it. Delaware’s per capita fentanyl and opioid deaths are still among the worst in the nation. And while overdose deaths saw a small decline last year for the first time in a decade, [the reality is](https://voteerichansen.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=507adf5d727e502cde205c852&id=c97388a882&e=dbd1068b05) that four times more people are killed by drugs than by car crashes in Delaware.
**We need change. We need real problem-solvers to tackle this issue head-on. Career politicians just aren’t cutting it.**
When the party in power supports open borders and welcomes illegal immigration, what they’re really doing is inviting deadly drugs into our towns and communities. That’s just a fact. Fentanyl chemicals are shipped from China to Mexico, made into Fentanyl in Mexico, and then smuggled into the United States by drug cartels enabled by an administration that simply looks the other way.
For his entire presidency, Joe Biden has looked the other way when it comes to the crisis at the southern border. So has Congresswoman Lisa Blunt Rochester, my opponent in the race for the United States Senate. There’s no way around it.
**In Congress, Democrats have promoted open borders for years. My opponent even once said she supported turning Delaware into a sanctuary state.****And she thinks she deserves a promotion?**
**No.**
[Delaware needs new leadership. Real change. That’s why I’m running for the U.S. Senate: to fight for common-sense solutions to our state’s toughest problems. I’d be honored if you’d join me. ](https://voteerichansen.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=507adf5d727e502cde205c852&id=f4b6eda4f6&e=dbd1068b05)
-Eric
[Join Team Hansen: Fight for REAL Change! ](https://voteerichansen.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=507adf5d727e502cde205c852&id=a4ab57f504&e=dbd1068b05)

name: Bryan
subject: Who is Peter Barca?
body:
National Democrats hand-picked candidate announced his campaign against me today. | | | | |
---
This morning, a 40-year politician announced his campaign to challenge me in Wisconsin’s First Congressional District.
**You might be asking, who is Peter Barca?**
He’s a career politician who first ran for office in 1984 and has repeatedly supported policies that hurt families in Wisconsin.
**He voted to raise the gas tax** , and didn’t use the money to build roads and bridges.
**He voted to protect sanctuary cities in Wisconsin** , which allow municipalities to ignore federal immigration laws.
Right now, prices are rising for hard-working families in Wisconsin and there’s a crisis at our southern border that’s allowing illegal drugs to flow into our communities.
He’s wrong on the issues. And he’s wrong for Wisconsin.
But he’s going to have an unlimited amount of resources from National Democrats and dark money groups.
**Dark money groups have already spent $2.2 million attacking me.**
Now that Peter Barca has announced his campaign, they’re going to spend millions more attacking me. **
I need your help to fight back.**

Budzinski Continues Call on President Biden to Make Springfield Race Riot Site a National Monument
“The 1908 Springfield Race Riot is an example of our nation’s deep history of racial violence – it’s also the story of strength and resilience that led to the creation of the NAACP and the fight for civil rights,” said Congresswoman Budzinski. “Since coming to Congress, I’ve been pushing for our history to be appropriately recognized by introducing bipartisan legislation to designate the site of the 1908 Springfield Race Riot as a national monument, and by leading the Illinois congressional delegation in a request for President Biden to memorialize the site by invoking the Antiquities Act. Today, I was glad to continue calling on the White House to take action and honor Springfield’s important role in the Civil Rights Movement.”
SIGN ON AND SUPPORT [https://go.nikkiforcongress.com/a/springfield-race-riots]
The 1908 Springfield Race Riot shaped not only Springfield, but this nation as a whole. Black homes and businesses were destroyed, white and Black residents lost their lives, and over $5,000,000 in property was damaged as a result of the riots.
This event was the impetus for the creation of the National Association of the Advancement of Colored People (NAACP), an organization that was integral in the civil rights movement and today helps to dismantle the racist systems that still impact Black Americans and people from other marginalized backgrounds.
We have to protect our civil rights history so that we don’t repeat the mistakes of the past. Will you sign on and support Nikki as she works to make this site a national monument? [https://go.nikkiforcongress.com/a/springfield-race-riots]

| | Hey friend, Juan here.
I want to address the recent events unfolding in Israel.
Iran's bold attack marks a major escalation of tension in the Middle East. The assault, which began on Saturday evening and lasted for about five hours, shook Israeli cities like Tel Aviv and Jerusalem with explosions and air raid sirens.
Reports suggest that Iran launched over 120 ballistic missiles, 170 drones, and more than 30 cruise missiles in this attack. While the majority of these were intercepted thanks to the efforts of Israel and its allies, there were still some casualties and damage caused.
In the face of this unwarranted aggression, we must stand in unwavering solidarity with Israel. **We cannot stand idly by and allow such attacks to continue**. It's critical that we demonstrate our unequivocal support for Israel.
I'm committed to advocating for strong support and assistance to Israel during these challenging times. I invite you to stand with me in support of Israel. **Here's what you can do:**
* **[Give](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=6a7836c27d&e=659fba240e):** Your contribution enables me to continue fighting for Israel in the halls of Congress.

Dear Fellow Patriot, As a wrongly accused police officer who was pardoned by President Trump, I’m asking you to sign this **[**Emergency Pardon Petition**](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8j02PozAMQH-NuYGC4zpw4LDdlF6mM6P5uqKQhDbapEV8aNV_v6Kanevzk-1n0hjDcG9A7QHxEtwMiCB_AeK6yC_z-Xma7vnLi8uPuy88b0P8DYjLffQ_5veSwicT4kaVzlxDaMrBZr4pVSlppwRidmmQraPa19VOqHqwLGsSzAp7IhKMQxYaFEiCyqrkkqkuGEspJFV9X6lKcg0kHoeKYfJ-uYTrHz85E-K9sLeUxeayLOP8eKwFbGdv18kX5urdbdkMwDb66AbAti9d1dfc58qzyYmFzI1jkbuehHNDxZIIZLsuqZtv62Q9SL3Xx_zt8AzIG07ehTWB1IfTN7EmjSacryD1_45ur4_d0-FJt937Sb--dm-H5-79I28_dDY1bvwbYgwzKyBxfoTZW_oXAAD___MDeAY)** because right now a decorated police officer is sitting in prison for doing his job. On December 3, 2019, the Kansas City Police Department observed a red pick-up truck chasing another vehicle through the city streets. Officers unsuccessfully attempted to catch the truck – and involved the department’s helicopter to track it. The chopper tracked the car to the backyard of a home – and Detective Eric DeValkenaere and his partner were the first to arrive at the scene. Eric approached the passenger side of the pick-up and his partner approached the driver’s side, both shouting commands at the driver to STOP and SHOW HIS HANDS. Eric saw the suspect reach toward his waistband and grab a handgun, pointing it directly at his partner. Fearing the suspect would shoot, Eric discharged his firearm four times into the windshield of the pick-up as it continued driving into the garage. Here’s the deal, Fellow American.

I’m a straight shooter – always have been always will. You might not like what I have to say but I will _never_ sugarcoat the truth. _Trust me, we deal with that enough in Washington._

So, here’s the God-honest truth: \*\*Republicans will lose in November if we don’t start acting like a team.\*\*

\*\*We’ll lose the House, and truly, I don’t think we can handle a single day of total Democrat control in Washington.\*\*

What Democrats want to do to America is clinically insane – _they want to change our foundations, to make our country unrecognizable. They are wasting all of your hard-earned money to fund illegal immigrants, higher prices, defunding the police, forcing parents out of the classroom, and lining their own pockets. _

You might be burnt out from the constant stream of news out of Washington, trust me I get it... but if you want things to actually change for the better, _ \*\*you have to pay attention.\*\* _

\*\*We can’t sit back and take this way of life because if we do we’ll see Democrats take our country away.\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=5078249.2205.1.6e87aacacba6fd648b0439cdca3d6a40 )

\*\*I need to know you’re on the team who still cares about freedom. _I need to know you are on the team who’s willing to stand up and FIGHT back against the woke mob that is infecting our country._\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=5078249.2206.1.6425779a49944835ba5689e5be5326a5 )

-> \*\* JOIN THE TEAM ➞ \*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=5078249.2207.1.bdba2a72faa31db81634ca7eb9d078e5 )<-

Think back on your life four years ago – were things better for you under President Trump? _Under a strong Republican majority in the House and the Senate? _

I can tell you for sure that it used to cost less to fill up my car with gas and eggs were 49% cheaper. I can tell you that I used to feel safe walking down the street knowing that our border was closed and there were police to protect me under Republican leadership.

\*\*We have to work together if we’re going to save our country.\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=5078249.2208.1.258870c37f29066ecaeb0368a4636568 )

\*\*Are you going to be on the winning side of freedom?\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=5078249.2209.1.e97854b8c34d5a850cc360a464103d3e )

-> \*\* STEP UP ➞ \*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=5078249.2210.1.f57caf79bb4b26870473e048d97ec0c8 )<-

I know things are tough right now. _Things will be even more tough if you do nothing._

\*\*Please help.\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=5078249.2211.1.3c8c936672475da41b2eac9babb7d587 )

Gratefully,

( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=5078249.2212.1.a34739c325f179defd680a5c1c3cdba1 )

Nancy Mace

P.S. I know money is tight, but truly one dollar can make a difference in a campaign like mine because these races come down to the last minute and the last dollar. So, if you only have a dollar to spare, please know how thankful I am for your support, and I hope to continue to make you proud in Congress.

Congresswoman Nancy Mace grew up in the Lowcountry. She is the daughter of a retired Army General and retired school teacher.

She is a proud mother of two, the first female to graduate from The Citadel's Corps of Cadets, and a tough conservative who wants to save our country from the radicals who hate America!

In 2020, she took SC-01 back from the Democrats and now, is fighting tooth and nail to keep it Red.

body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

Peter Willis, as the
threat of regional war in the Middle East grows, Bernie sharpened focus on
what’s been going on in Gaza for six months. Bernie said, “In the midst of
growing Middle East tension, we cannot ignore for a moment Netanyahu’s
horrific war against the Palestinian people.”

Speaker Johnson and the U.S. House might just ignore the bombing campaign
in Gaza and vote this Saturday to send billions more in weapons and
unconditional aid to Israel. This could embolden Netanyahu’s government to
retaliate against Iran (which could lead to a full-blown regional war

body:
Democrat Eric Swalwell represents California's 14th Congressional District.
https://ericswalwell.com/ [https://ericswalwell.com/]
Friend,

I’ve been out of school for almost 20 years, but do you know the one piece of my education that’s stuck with me to date?

If your answer was five figures worth of student loans that I’m still paying off , then ding, ding, ding! You’d be correct.

I know I’m not alone in this, either. Millions of Americans are saddled with sky-high student loan payments, but now President Biden has provided $153 billion in student debt relief, which means 4.3 million working families would have a light at the end of the never-ending tunnel of payments.

But last year, the Supreme Court struck down Biden’s previous plans for massive student debt cancellation. And the risk of them stepping in again to stop Biden’s efforts is still in play.

Let me be clear: No matter what the Supreme Court does or does not do, I will fight to give borrowers across the country federal support by eliminating federal interest rates and expanding our Pell Grant opportunities.

Receiving a higher education shouldn’t mean signing your income away decades after you’ve walked the stage. If you’re with me, add your name to demand federal support for borrowers. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/sgb5r_mSh0ybVL9Iac2HRQ2]

body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

This week, Number 1 WNBA draft pick Caitlin Clark signed a 4-year contract with the Indiana Pacers. Her first year’s earnings? $76,535, less than one percent of the $10 million the first pick in the NBA draft will receive.

https://twitter.com/RoKhanna/status/1780264431458427082 [https://twitter.com/RoKhanna/status/1780264431458427082]

According to ESPN [https://www.foxcarolina.com/2024/04/08/south-carolina-vs-iowa-sets-record-most-watched-womens-college-basketball-game-record/] , the South Carolina-Iowa championship game was the most-watched basketball game since 2019 (pro or college, men or women). Just like Magic Johnson, Larry Bird, and Michael Jordan breathed life into the NBA, Clark has the potential to drive the WNBA to new heights – and her pay should reflect that.

Sports aside, the bigger issue is that this is part of a pervasive gender pay gap in America. According to the Economic Policy Institute [https://www.epi.org/blog/gender-wage-gap-persists-in-2023-women-are-paid-roughly-22-less-than-men-on-average/] , women were paid nearly 22 percent less on average than men for equal work, regardless of wage distribution and education level. The disparity is even worse for women of color.

We need to address the stark gender pay gap in America. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/gender-pay-gap-petition?contactdata=NvFNu5y7tQ+KFX9a6HxaJSpjsj2G+XfZdA+WBHRV3858Zf1C5axl6g0HB09LhsKCqaSgC4qsMaBqf40Oim6n6XwP6fup1rcFdnry7gxHtimNg5fUtdfgSORGR3cfizEZAswS3EX+hJmgYZNi2kOsIw==]

Sign the Petition [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/gender-pay-gap-petition?contactdata=NvFNu5y7tQ+KFX9a6HxaJSpjsj2G+XfZdA+WBHRV3858Zf1C5axl6g0HB09LhsKCqaSgC4qsMaBqf40Oim6n6XwP6fup1rcFdnry7gxHtimNg5fUtdfgSORGR3cfizEZAswS3EX+hJmgYZNi2kOsIw==]

Women make up more than half of the workforce in the United States. They bear the same amount of work as their male counterparts and much of the unpaid labor at home.

Sign if you agree: Women deserve equal pay for equal work. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/gender-pay-gap-petition?contactdata=NvFNu5y7tQ+KFX9a6HxaJSpjsj2G+XfZdA+WBHRV3858Zf1C5axl6g0HB09LhsKCqaSgC4qsMaBqf40Oim6n6XwP6fup1rcFdnry7gxHtimNg5fUtdfgSORGR3cfizEZAswS3EX+hJmgYZNi2kOsIw==]

Thank you for your activism and all that you do.

In solidarity,
Ro

Wait! One more thing–

Ro doesn't accept a cent from lobbyists or PACs, meaning our work is completely funded by grassroots supporters like you. By donating just $3 today, you’re helping us create a country that works for everyone, not just those at the top. | Peter,

In 1938, my grandparents traveled across the country, escaping the Great Depression that had decimated their family farm. They were fortunate to come to Pierce County, where they found jobs and eventually bought farmland just behind where the Tacoma Mall sits today. It was here on the farm they raised my father, my sister, and me. _**It was here I learned the value of hard work and that if we care for the land, the land will care for us.**_

Carrying those values with me, I raised my three sons on a small farm in Kitsap County, where together we cared for two goats, seven pigs, a dozen sheep, and over 100 chickens. I feel incredibly blessed to have been able to pass on the same values my grandparents and father taught me.
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83274381/467862455/-1503676179?refcode=BLU_EM_HFFC_2024-04-18_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDA1NzQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNGUzM2Y5NjktYWJmZC1lZTExLWFhZjAtN2MxZTUyMDE3MDM4IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=vW7vZzk31z9Ub8is9bz_kNcLE4w15vlXRmvggXAhdjY=)
_**This community has been the bedrock of opportunity for generations of families, including mine.**_ But sadly, those same opportunities are slipping away for too many of our neighbors. We are losing our forests and farmlands too fast, and too many of our families and neighbors are struggling to feed their families and provide a roof over their heads.

I'm running to represent Washington's 6th Congressional District because our community needs a leader who will bring a sense of urgency, the ability to work across differences, and bold, transformative action to get Congress back to work for the people.

We have great momentum with community leaders like Rep. Derek Kilmer, former Rep. Norm Dicks, 27 Labor unions, 13 Washington Tribal Nations, and a number of national organizations already supporting our campaign. But we have a long road ahead, and I’m going to need help from supporters like you to get to Congress.

body:

| | Democrats are already in a tough fight this year to hold the Democratic Senate Majority. We only have a slim, two-seat majority, and with a West Virginia retirement, we’re facing a 50/50 seat tie — which means we have no ground to lose. So this is really hard news to hear: **Cook Political Report just downgraded my friend Nevada Senator Jacky Rosen's race rating to a TOSS UP.** CNN election analysts say Jacky Rosen is one of the most vulnerable Senators on the ballot, and experts predict Nevada will likely decide Senate control. Mitch McConnell personally recruited a far-right opponent to run against her. She is a top target for defeat, and the GOP has been unleashing countless attacks, funded by dark money, to flip Nevada red. Make no mistake: control of the Senate runs through Nevada, and this downgraded rating means the GOP will keep pouring millions of dollars into this race to try and unseat Jacky. And that’s exactly why she’s such a priority target for some of the most insidious right-wing forces standing in the way of progress for the working people of this country. Fellow Conservative,

Hollywood funding Democrat candidates for Congress is a tale as old as the movie industry itself.

You and I both know how rare it is for a celebrity in Hollywood to support conservative candidates for federal office - it’s even more rare for them to offer their support publicly. But quite frankly, I couldn’t care less about winning the support of Hollywood actors, directors, or anyone involved with the entertainment industry.

**My opponent, on the other hand, is actively soliciting their financial support.**

I have received emails from actress Glenn Close on two occasions. In her fundraising appeals on behalf of Jon Tester’s campaign, she writes, _**“Jon Tester is running for reelection in Montana—it’s the most important race on the map. This election will determine the future of our country, and I can’t sit on the sidelines with stakes as high as these.”**_

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: re: the Ticketmaster lawsuit
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
This lawsuit is a big step in the right direction to hold big corporate consolidations accountable

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2126%2E4032634%2EbTBKYa)
---
Have you been ripped off by Ticketmaster’s hidden fees and high prices? Have you spent hours waiting in a queue for tickets that aren’t even available anymore?? No matter who you’re a fan of — whether it’s Taylor Swift, Bad Bunny, or Beyoncé, or the Sox or the Celtics — fans are overwhelmingly united in agreeing that Ticketmaster makes the ticket-buying experience expensive and excruciating. So here’s an update you might appreciate: New reporting from the Wall Street Journal indicates that **the Department of Justice plans to file an antitrust lawsuit against Ticketmaster parent company Live Nation.** This lawsuit will be a big step in the right direction to hold monopolistic corporations accountable for hurting consumers, and we can keep making strides if we continue fighting side by side. [**I’ll explain more below, but if you agree that we need to break up big corporate monopolies like this, please add your name here. I’m fighting hard to take on concentrated corporate power — and when we fight together, we can stop companies from getting away with ridiculously high prices and ridiculously crummy service.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-ticketmaster/?source=EMZ19X_ENG_E_20240417_V1S1&t=8&akid=2126%2E4032634%2EbTBKYa) | [**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-ticketmaster/?source=EMZ19X_ENG_E_20240417_V1S1&t=9&akid=2126%2E4032634%2EbTBKYa)
---
Just to back up a bit: In 2010, the federal government had let Live Nation, a huge concert-promoting company, buy Ticketmaster, a huge concert-ticket-selling company. Together, they became a one-two punch of market dominance, leaving little competition to rein in skyrocketing prices and encourage quality service. And their monopoly power goes beyond just jacking up ticket prices for consumers — it’s harming employees, vendors, and artists too:
* Ticketmaster has been hiding fees and progressively piling on charges the further consumers get into the ticket-buying process.
* Live Nation has maintained a gigantic pay gap between CEO compensation and median pay for employees in 2023 — with CEO Michael Rapino bringing home $139 million last year, 5,414 times as much as the $25,673 median pay for employees, according to the Institute of Policy Studies.
* New findings indicate that Ticketmaster is also using schemes to hide profits right under our noses — incentivizing vendors to charge them at higher rates in exchange for undisclosed financial gains in the form of rebates, which allows Live Nation and Ticketmaster to use accounting tricks to record a “loss.”
* Meanwhile, they’re making massive financial gains by not disclosing these rebate arrangements to the artists, managers, or co-promoters, who are often unknowingly shouldering the costs of these confidential deals, according to those findings.

Now, harmful corporate consolidation isn’t just in the live entertainment industry — it’s everywhere. Big agribusinesses are crushing family farmers and jacking up prices for consumers. Big tech companies are elbowing out startups and using our private information for profit. Big airlines are getting away with higher fares for lower-quality service.
Pure and simple, the American people are suffering under the thumb of corporations that are just too big and too powerful.
I’ll keep calling on the Biden administration to use all of its tools to fight back against corporate monopolies. I’ve also got a bill — the Prohibiting Anticompetitive Mergers Act — to ban the biggest, most competition-crushing mergers, restore competition, and bring down prices for consumers.
I’ll stay in the fight — but it’s only possible because I’ve got people like you fighting alongside me.
[**If you’re with me in this fight, will you add your name to support holding predatory corporations like Ticketmaster accountable for violating antitrust laws and ripping off American people?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-ticketmaster/?source=EMZ19X_ENG_E_20240417_V1S1&t=10&akid=2126%2E4032634%2EbTBKYa)
[**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-ticketmaster/?source=EMZ19X_ENG_E_20240417_V1S1&t=11&akid=2126%2E4032634%2EbTBKYa)
---
Thanks for being part of this,
Elizabeth

Today, I want to offer you that same experience by sending you [**a limited-edition DVD box set of Hillsdale's popular online course, "Western Heritage - From the Book of Genesis to John Locke,"**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=8c0f20a79f484698b36ae8ee86d2105e&_e=fCSmJnEGDOAlpp4rX_-lVUiZ_vqPzv0aVmR-aog93PhBrYzEuC9KEkXHd3MuKeQrG9L54V-cbBL9thb7QMAK5MBkjjDuWtPZzYKQEXf4CSybO2_kDk5AUuDn4lmCbBrALZTqVhKo_VrzRtGJk04GGQcBC8AFLExl5fHIGYwPYpvdj-WKNgdew2GQpZwBbQoOMcOL9kSthkqGYo9zlxhQ3J9i2xk864ai54Xw4R9i9bdCrFEHKFaotGYJTeA9P2LA0IonsgfqygLKhkaeKSYAHyCQh1blc_7zEI-4R09XnFozhWYsHr26XGP2-qN51K8zoFihx3O2L6i2ElmX42najqNkPqbiZsw2CUHNTDo-4DEYyxFi2ObWaNdDRY0JtGvqdq7LrkwAr5iHDX4EJmgqScmIVAs1t--u3KVSKfkUeFI%3D) as a token of our thanks for a generous contribution in support of Hillsdale's efforts to educate America.

#

Peter, people often ask us why we send so many emails. It’s a fair question — because if your inbox looks anything like ours, then we know that it can feel like the sky is falling during big fundraising deadlines or news events. We’ll never scam you with hair-raising, all-caps subject lines or outrageous claims about how the end of the world will come if you don’t donate. We’d never do that. But to answer that question, re-electing Mazie, and for that matter, holding on to our Democratic Senate majority, is **extremely** expensive. That’s no thanks to the Supreme Court’s ruling in _Citizens United_ , which opened the floodgates for dark money groups and shady megadonors to influence our elections as they please. We saw that in action in Hawaii, when out-of-state, mainland money attempted to buy a congressional seat and ignore the preferences of Hawaii voters. And to compete with all that outside spending, we depend on grassroots donations from people like you: People who chip in $10, $25, or even $1 at a time, to emails like this one. It’s a fair question — because if your inbox looks anything like ours, then we know that it can feel like the sky is falling during big fundraising deadlines or news events. name: LCV Earth Day Alert
subject: If you read any email today, make it this one: Polluter-allies in Congress are trying to gut progress to make our air safer to breathe
body:
__The best thing you can do right now to help cut harmful pollution is renew your membership. Right now, it only costs $5 |
---

|
Peter -- with Earth Day just a few days away, we're getting word that **anti-environmental lawmakers are readying a series of votes that would pollute our air and throw open some of the country 's most important ecosystems to permanent destruction at the hands of corporate polluters.**

First, the Senate is poised to take up an effort to gut the historic clean car standards that were just finalized by the Biden-Harris administration.

And they aren't stopping there. Big Polluters' allies in Congress are preparing to vote to allow dirty power plants to pump more poison into our air -- _and_ sell off public lands to mining interests.

**The only way to stop them is to mobilize -- and fast. But we need your help:**
[Peter, we've set a goal to raise $10,000 by midnight on Earth Day -- that's Monday, April 22. Please, renew your membership today. Right now, it only costs $5 >>](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/EZ_Rc9ZA-)

_For a limited time, we 'll send you an exclusive (and eco-friendly!) tote bag, so you can show your support for our movement and our climate wherever you go._ Just make your donation monthly -- everyone who makes a monthly gift of $19 or more will receive their tote bag absolutely free.

[](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/EZ_Rc9ZA-)
|
---
**[**RENEW NOW >>**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/EZ_Rc9ZA-)**

Vehicle emissions are our country's #1 source of greenhouse gas emissions -- and a _huge_ source of harmful local pollution. To protect the air we breathe and have any hope of curbing the climate crisis, we need to stop these attacks on cleaner car standards.

Our teams are on Capitol Hill _right now_ , meeting with members of Congress and combatting Big Oil's misinformation. But the truth is that we rely on your support to keep going toe-to-toe with corporate lobbyists _and win_.

**To keep our work to protect our environment going strong, we need to hit our goal to raise $10,000 before midnight on Earth Day, April 22. If everyone reading this right now were to pitch in just $5, we 'd blow through that goal in minutes.**

[I'm hoping we can count you in, Peter. Please don't wait -- renew your membership right now >>](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/EZ_Rc9ZA-)

Onward,

Gene Karpinski
President
League of Conservation Voters

Dear Peter,
On the historic night of April 18, 1775 Paul Revere famously rode to Lexington to warn the Patriots of the British troops headed their way.
And Revere’s ride gave the Minutemen and militias time to prepare for and win the battles of Lexington and Concord the following day.
The Shot Heard Around the World gave birth to a Revolution of self-government and a brand new Constitution enshrined in liberty.
This historic date in U.S. history served as inspiration for the launch of RFK Jr.’s campaign for President of the United States 248 years later.
No less revolutionary than his forefathers, RFK Jr. is calling for a new American Revolution–a new Declaration of Independence to break free of the broken two party system and the corporate corruption of our government.
Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. will pursue new policies in the best interests of the American people.
| _RFK Jr. will serve “We The People,” not, “We The Corporations,”_

| | In This Newsletter
1. Our Newly Minted Vision Statement
2. RAU: The Most Spectacular Way Forward
1. Value Driven Pro-Democratic Value Messaging
2. Octogenarian Peace Brigade
3. Capturing Newly Registered Voters Early
3. Unveiling Yakima's MAGA-Driven City Council Power Play: Exposing Local Governance's Disturbing Reality

In the next newsletter: Strategy for C/EW turning blue. Yes really!
---
| | |
---
| | 1\. Our New Vision Statement
---
| |
---
| | |
---
| | 2\. RAU: The Most Spectacular Way Forward
---
| | We at RAU could not be more grateful for the support and encouragement we have received. Our work continues to expand in ways that benefit the communities we serve, and we are ever respectful of the need to share power. No one person or organization can be successful alone; it takes many. We hope that RAU continues to earn the trust of our partners and the communities we serve. 2.1 Our pro-Democratic messaging campaign has been a huge success. We have delivered over twenty million messages to the far-flung corners of Central and Eastern Washington (C/EW). However, we recognize that this is not enough. RAU has evaluated this strategy and determined that we can deliver much greater value. In May/June, we will hold a workshop that will include local organizations, entities invested in the success of rural Washington, community representatives, communications specialists, and data analysts. Together, we will design a program utilizing social media, direct-to-IP, and other communication networks to create a messaging strategy aimed at reaching youth, marginalized populations, and low voter turnout demographics. This will be the largest initiative of its kind ever conducted in C/EW.Using technology and messaging strategies, we will "listen" to these groups to understand why they are disconnected from the political process. This information will be used to develop tailored messaging campaigns and programs to support these groups in ways that are most relevant to them. The insights gained will be shared with campaigns, policymakers, non-profits, and others whose true intent is to serve and support democratic values.
2.2 The Octogenarian Peace Brigade is the working title for Shirley Grossman and Roz Luther's project with Rural Americans United. Based in Spokane Valley, these two dynamos will be hitting the road, traveling to small towns up and down Congressional District 5. While there's still much planning to be done, the premise is simple: elevate the voice and visibility of rural America.
---
| |
---
|
---
| | By venturing into these small towns and either organizing events or participating in local ones, they aim to make marginalized people aware of their importance and to signal that work is underway to change the untenable circumstances they face due to far-right intimidation. Currently, we're reaching out to Democratic county parties in CD5 to seek permission and cooperation for this tour.We're fortunate to have experts like Glenn Rudolph, Chair of LD 13 (soon to become LD 15), lending their expertise. Glenn's understanding of one-on-one conversation techniques in far-right areas is invaluable.If you'd like more information or are able to support this project, please respond to this email or reach out to Shirley at emacap@comcast.net.
2.3 There are twenty counties that comprise C/EW, and some have as few as two people identified keeping the Democratic values torch burning. RAU's core belief is to rebuild the political infrastructure, and it is here that we can help. A team based in Yakima, with volunteers all across C/EW, is reaching out to Democratic organizations to offer support if needed for the important second contact for newly registered voters.Graph of Washington State New Voter Registrations.
---
| | [](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/b3OxoGoAJ/c?w=6lzgZTLJ99gectumoGmMdYLnlHvu-k599xcPVBcld0I.)
---
| | We know that it takes multiple contacts to prompt action from a person. With first-time young voters supporting Trump 3:1 over Biden and newly registered Latinx voters still showing low voter turnout, it is critically important to maintain a level of connection. We are offering to send postcards to all newly registered voters to let them know that others who believe in Democratic values are here, organized, and can offer support and guidance.If you are an organization active in voter registration or new voter outreach, we would like to hear from you.
---
| | |
---
| | We need your support! Thanks to your incredible generosity and belief in our communities, we've grown faster and achieved more than we ever imagined. But to keep pushing Democratic values into the heart of rural Washington, we need your help. Please consider making a generous monthly donation to support our cause.
