| | 3\. Unveiling Yakima's MAGA-Driven City Council Power Play: Exposing Local Governance's Disturbing Reality
---
| | What has been shared in previous newsletters are fragments that comprise a larger picture: a concerted effort to seize control of local government, reshape it as an effective tool, and impose a narrow and unpopular ideology on the majority, thereby distorting and corrupting the very foundation of our nation – democracy. ([read more in last newsletter](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/b3OxoGoAJ/c?w=i8y5p5X5KXGx6t_jUcs-RubTava24pvF-ejJfI5KTsA.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucnVyYWxhbWVyaWNhbnN1bml0ZWQub3JnL3Bvc3QvcnVyYWwtdm9pY2VzLXJlc3RvcmluZy1lcXVpdHktdG8tb3VyLWVsZWN0aW9uLXByb2Nlc3MiLCJyIjoiMThiODhkZTEtNjBmMC00NDY3LTkxNmEtOGEyNzE2YjUyMmQ0IiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0))The MAGA members of the Yakima City Council (MMYCC) recently moved to diminish community input on council decisions by disconnecting from several Community Committees addressing issues such as Climate and Diversity. These committees previously had a legal bond with the Council, necessitating collaboration. However, MAGA's aversion to oversight led to their dissolution. Mayor Patricia Byers justified this action by stating that the committees could now operate more freely, but in reality, they have been stripped of authority, leaving the MMYCC unaccountable to community input or oversight.This is not the first brazen attempt by the MMYCC to reshape the Council and local government to advance the Project 2025 agenda. It's alarming to witness how easily our government can be corrupted, with few checks in place to protect against such abuse.Project 2025, when implemented at the local level, is termed "Territorial Transformation." A Facebook post revealed that Yakima City Mayor Patricia Byers, Council member Mathew Brown, and Council member Chip Roy were welcoming [Sean Feucht](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/b3OxoGoAJ/c?w=mCfaQEBp4FSwHG8TOoyppjAt4Sa99UUwMcZgkcVPg54.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cub3BiLm9yZy9hcnRpY2xlLzIwMjMvMDgvMDEvcGFjaWZpYy1ub3J0aHdlc3QtZmFpdGgtbGVhZGVycy1kZW5vdW5jZS1zZWFuLWZldWNodC10b3VyLW92ZXItaGF0ZWZ1bC1yaGV0b3JpYy8iLCJyIjoiMThiODhkZTEtNjBmMC00NDY3LTkxNmEtOGEyNzE2YjUyMmQ0IiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0) to Yakima's [SOZO Sports Complex on June 9, 2024](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/b3OxoGoAJ/c?w=RNLIX38oBSx5Pyir4eYAnDhYAzhGIi1fJKQJAvzBZX8.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZmFjZWJvb2suY29tL2V2ZW50cy83MjY5NDU0NjE5Nzg3Nzg4LyIsInIiOiIxOGI4OGRlMS02MGYwLTQ0NjctOTE2YS04YTI3MTZiNTIyZDQiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ). Feucht's ministry espouses Christian Nationalism and is vehemently anti-LGBT, shedding light on why the Community Diversity and Inclusion Committee was axed by the MMYCC. Machinations are proceeding with disturbing precision.
---
| |
---
| | Lastly, the Yakima City Council's proclamation recognizing May 2, 2024, as National Prayer Day raises concerns. While a day of prayer may not be objectionable, falsely attributing a religious role in the founding of America undermines the secular nature of our government and the freedom to worship, or not, as one chooses.The purpose of starting the National Day of Prayer was to humbly come before God, seeking His guidance for our leaders and His grace upon us as a people. However, the first amendment of the constitution states, "Congress shall make no law respecting an establishment of religion." Manipulating local government is shown to be more effective than State or Federal levels due to lesser oversight. Mayor Patricia Byers' reasoning for disconnecting the Community Committees from the government seems accurate for a day of prayer, but counter to the purpose of Community Committees.
---
| | [](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/b3OxoGoAJ/c?w=PmOPhdMfxE443IEkYUtDCtYK09X9SgJqJnYILNXNkFc.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubmF0aW9uYWxkYXlvZnByYXllci5vcmcvYWJvdXQiLCJyIjoiNWJkMTFlNDAtMjMzZi00NTlhLTg1ZWItOTc1YTg5ZjA2YjczIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0)
---
| | |
---
| | Lastly, while a proclamation may not seem like a "serious" government action, [Washington State RCW 38.08.030](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/b3OxoGoAJ/c?w=0IpnfPZwGeQP1gdI80zF6VN_pARt841XPLWqwYSri4k.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9hcHAubGVnLndhLmdvdi9yY3cvZGVmYXVsdC5hc3B4P2NpdGU9MzguMDguMDMwIiwiciI6IjcxY2QyYWI1LTZiYjQtNGQ3Zi04YjQxLTVhMmEzODg3Mjc5MiIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9) outlines a Proclamation of complete or limited martial law by the Governor. These small twists and turns gradually erode our trust in our system of government creating fear and confusion. In Central and Eastern Washington young voters were three times more likely to cast their ballot for Trump than for Biden and Democratic voter turnout was down 42%! Rural Americans United was created to fight back. We educate, remind and persuade people that Democratic Values mirror theirs the best and will provide a future that benefits us all. We provide a strong voice for Democratic Values across Central and Eastern Washington.

( MAGA members of the Yakima City Council (MMYCC) recently moved to diminish community input on council decisions by disconnecting from several Community Committees addressing issues such as Climate and Diversity. It's alarming to witness how easily our government can be corrupted, with few checks in place to protect against such abuse.Project 2025, when implemented at the local level, is termed "Territorial Transformation." For more than 100 years, we’ve been pushing and advocating for equal rights to be guaranteed for all people, regardless of sex or gender identity. ...Meaning the ERA is older than: 🚦Traffic Signals 💊Antibiotics 🖊️Ballpoint Pens 💻Computers In 2017, 2018, and 2020, Nevada, Illinois, and Virginia became the last states needed—and the first in over 40 years—to ratify the ERA. But the ERA’s ratification was by the Trump Administration in 2020 and held up in litigation over an arbitrary deadline that Congress passed in 1978. But make no mistake: there can be no deadline for achieving our full constitutional gender equality. Now, Congress has the opportunity to the ERA, and send it to the archivist to publish it as the 28th Amendment. With Cori in Congress, we have someone fighting every day for the equality of all people, especially our most marginalized communities. Ultimately, the ERA will cement gender equality into our constitution and advance so many of the fundamental rights we are fighting for – like protecting abortion rights, ending the gender wage gap, furthering liberation for our queer and transgender communities, ensuring equal access to healthcare, voting rights access, and so much more... subject: Arizona and Maryland
body:
Friend,

After Roe v. Wade was overturned, states have been left to their own accord on the issue of abortion. This sets a dangerous precedent, as the far-right works to roll back the clock and pass their extremist agenda to erode reproductive rights.
The most recent example of this is in Arizona. Their Supreme Court just allowed an outdated law from 1864 to enact a near-total abortion ban. This is a step in the wrong direction — abortion is a private matter, one that should lie in the hands of individuals, not the government.

Now is the time to fight back. We’re supporting state initiatives to protect reproductive rights — including the ballot initiative here in Maryland and the Arizona initiative to protect against these extreme bans. If you are ready, split a donation between Arizona and Maryland’s ballot initiatives right now. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20240418-1?refcode=em20240418]

Donate » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20240418-1?refcode=em20240418]

The Arizona Abortion Access Act is a ballot initiative that is designed to guarantee individuals the right to privacy and to be empowered to make their own decisions regarding their healthcare without government interference.

In Maryland, we are fighting for the Reproductive Freedom Referendum — which, if passed, will codify the right to an abortion in the Maryland state constitution. Maryland has already been leading the fight for reproductive justice, but there is still work to be done.

Wes, alongside other leaders, is fighting tooth and nail to empower citizens and guarantee access to reproductive care. One of Wes’ very first acts as governor was to release $3.5 million to support abortion care access that had been blocked by his Republican predecessor. Elections matter, and this year is not any different. Abortion access and reproductive access are on the ballot, and we must support all efforts to protect this right for all of us.

You can help us now by donating $5 or whatever you can afford today to support these initiatives and defend the right to reproductive rights in Maryland and Arizona this November. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20240418-1?refcode=em20240418]

Donate » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20240418-1?refcode=em20240418]

Thank you for all that you do,

Team Moore

name: Sarah McBride
subject: Standing firm for gun safety
body:
Five years ago this month, still an advocate, I joined my friends with Moms Demand Action at the introduction of three major gun safety bills.
#
Five years ago this month, still an advocate, I joined my friends with Moms Demand Action at the introduction of **three major gun safety bills** : an assault weapons ban, a requirement for a permit to purchase, and ban on high-capacity magazines.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240418-1?refcode=em20240418-1&amount=5&refcode2=84_21716_9_v89K&akid=84%2E21716%2E9_v89K)
We were shouted down by hundreds of NRA activists, but we stood firm and continued to push.
**Five years later, I’m proud that as a state senator, I cosponsored and voted for each of these bills — and, as of last month,_all_ have now passed the General Assembly!**
We also banned the use of devices that convert handguns into fully automatic weapons, raised the age to purchase most firearms from 18 to 21, strengthened background checks, and made it possible to hold gun manufacturers and dealers liable for reckless or negligent actions that lead to gun violence.
**We’ve taken on the NRA and passed real gun safety laws here in Delaware. That's why I recently received the Moms Demand Action Gun Sense Candidate distinction. I’m ready to do it again in Congress, but I’m counting on your support to win this race first.**

Five years ago this month, still an advocate, I joined my friends with Moms Demand Action at the introduction of three major gun safety bills : an assault weapons ban, a requirement for a permit to purchase, and ban on high-capacity magazines. We were shouted down by hundreds of NRA activists, but we stood firm and continued to push. Five years later, I’m proud that as a state senator, I cosponsored and voted for each of these bills — and, as of last month,all have now passed the General Assembly! We also banned the use of devices that convert handguns into fully automatic weapons, raised the age to purchase most firearms from 18 to 21, strengthened background checks, and made it possible to hold gun manufacturers and dealers liable for reckless or negligent actions that lead to gun violence. We’ve taken on the NRA and passed real gun safety laws here in Delaware. That's why I recently received the Moms Demand Action Gun Sense Candidate distinction. name: Jeffrey Clark
subject: A quick update and a very sincere thank you
body:
They’re trying to take away my ability to practice law and feed my family. | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us1.campaign-archive.com/?e=17913c7d6d&u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=38c3672809)
---
| | |
---
| | | Friends,

I asked Russ if I could give you all a quick update, but first, let me say this from the bottom of my heart. [Thank you for standing with me](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=6c62e65933&e=17913c7d6d).

**I can’t tell you how much it’s meant to me and my family. **

In case you don’t know my backstory - I've fought to preserve and defend the U.S. Constitution for my entire career. And that’s exactly what I did when I served President Trump honorably in the Justice Department and fought for the integrity of our election in 2020.

I knew that would put a target on my back, but I confess I did not know how far those seeking to destroy our Republic would go to silence me.

In March of 2023 I was indicted alongside Trump and others in a kangaroo process in Fulton County, GA and it didn’t stop there. For the past year they waged a character assassination campaign against me; dragging my good name through the mud.
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=6d72afa117&e=17913c7d6d)
---
| _My mugshot from Fulton County, GA last year._
---
| Now they’re going one step further. **They’re trying to take away my ability to practice law and feed my family.**

This past month the D.C. Bar put me through a sham trial and issued their first “disciplinary” ruling against me for my legal work in the 2020 election. It was rigged from the very beginning, but it’s a first step towards officially disbarring me.

It’s a long road ahead and disbarring me is anything but certain, but I'm not giving up. I won’t be silenced. Yes I've taken some arrows, but with CRA and so many of you standing by my side, it’s only strengthened my resolve to keep fighting.

**[If you want to stand with me, here is the best way to do so](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=22b55bccae&e=17913c7d6d). **

If you’re not able, I understand, but don’t ever stop fighting for our country.

With sincere gratitude,
---
| Jeff Clark
Director of Litigation, Center for Renewing America

ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
What's On Your Mind [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/LFC%20Digital%20Header.png]

March has come and gone. With it, Super Tuesday and the Texas primaries. I’m proud once again to be your Democratic nominee for our #TX07 race.
Our team and I have been traveling across the district a lot in recent weeks and I’ve heard from Texans about the issues and concerns on people’s minds—from the future of abortion access in Texas and across the country, to gun violence and public safety, and so much more.
It’s great when I can speak with Texans face to face to hear how people in our community are feeling. Email gives me another way I can get these types of insights, and today, I want to hear from you.
I want to know what’s on your mind as we head into the rest of the election year. What are your hopes and your biggest concerns?
Who we elect this year will determine how we address the issues we care about—or whether we address them at all. That’s why it’s critical that we not only win our race but also flip the House, elect Democrats like Colin Allred to the Senate, and send President Biden back to the White House.
Our team is working hard to prepare for not only our race but also to support these other important races happening across our state and country. That’s how we can deliver the leadership we need and deserve at every level of government.
As we get ready to cast our ballots for those candidates, I want to know what’s on your mind and which issues are driving you to the ballot box in 2024. Please reply directly to this email and let me know.
Together, we can do anything,

name: Hill Harper
subject: Here’s my concrete plan to curb gun violence. No fluff, no B.S.
disclaimer_text: paid for by the NRA
body:
It’s time to ban assault weapons and make our streets safer.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1175%2E62735%2EdqQa_x)
Quick question for you, Peter: **Why haven’t our leaders solved America’s gun violence problem?**
It’s unconscionable. Our churches, schools, movie theaters, grocery stores, and even Super Bowl parades have all become ground zero for the gun violence epidemic. All the while, our leaders in Washington are raking in big money from groups like the NRA.
As the father of an eight-year-old, this is personal for me. I’ll never forget the day Pierce told me he was afraid to go to school after participating in multiple active shooter drills in his class — it broke my heart. We’re talking about elementary school students here — they should be learning how to _read and write_ , not how to hide from gunfire.
**This is NOT the America we want or deserve.**
That’s why I promise to fight tirelessly in the Senate to ensure our communities are safe. My plan focuses on enacting tougher gun laws, addressing the root causes of violence through meaningful criminal justice reform, and delivering universal health care to provide the mental health services folks need.
Of course, we’ll never make major progress on _any_ of these policies in a Senate where too many politicians are bought and paid for by the NRA. Throw in the fact that just 40% of the Senate holds the power to block any bill with the Jim Crow-era filibuster rule, and banning military-style assault weapons will be _even harder._
**That’s why I can’t emphasize this enough, Peter:** Ending the epidemic of gun violence will require sustained effort from our elected leaders AND people like you who care about building a safer future. I’m all-in on this fight, so my question is: _Are you with me?_
**[I know you are, so please: Take just 30 seconds to add your name to my petition calling on Congress to do more to end gun violence. We must do more to keep our communities safe, and it all starts with our leaders in Washington>>>](https://act.hillharper.com/survey/em_HHR_FR_GunViolence_041824?source=em_HHR_FR_GunViolence_041824&t=2&akid=1175%2E62735%2EdqQa_x)**
**[SIGN THE PETITION](https://act.hillharper.com/survey/em_HHR_FR_GunViolence_041824?source=em_HHR_FR_GunViolence_041824&t=3&akid=1175%2E62735%2EdqQa_x)**
Thank you for standing with me. Together, we can turn our hopes for a safer tomorrow into a reality.
Hill Harper
Democrat for U.S. Senate

clean_body: I’m building power with young undocumented people, join me! | | | Hi Peter, ✊I’m Ivonne and I’ve been a leader with The Squad since 2021. I felt called to build a community with undocumented young people across the country after my job let me go for over a month when my DACA expired because of the renewal backlog. Myself and my family are under a constant threat of detention and deportation every day that we don’t have permanent protections, and that really takes a toll on our mental health. The Squad has provided me a space to gain leadership skills and make impactful connections with people who share my experience too.💪 DACA has been a lifeline for thousands of families like mine, but it’s really just a band-aid solution. Our immigrant communities are already such a powerful force despite the barriers we face, imagine how much we can accomplish with the liberation and economic freedom that a pathway to citizenship would provide. 🧡I hope to see you in our Squad spaces soon! Ivonne and the rest of the The Squad

Hi Peter,
Last month was truly madness here at Team Terán! We had our big end-of-quarter fundraising deadline AND the deadline to submit our nominating petition to make sure Raquel made the primary ballot.
Thanks to supporters like you, we hit both deadlines out of the park! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftteran?refcode=X_041824_aprcampaignupdate] However, a campaign like ours is more than just raising money and collecting signatures... it’s also connecting with voters, meeting local organizations (and occasionally, cheering on the Diamondbacks!) Below are some of our favorite photos from the last month of everything happening on the ground here at Team Terán:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftteran?refcode=X_041824_aprcampaignupdate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftteran?refcode=X_041824_aprcampaignupdate]
Team Terán has been hard at work canvassing and tabling across AZ-03. We were lucky enough to be joined by Quantá Crews, who is running for the Arizona House!
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftteran?refcode=X_041824_aprcampaignupdate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftteran?refcode=X_041824_aprcampaignupdate]
Ironworkers Local 75 invited Raquel to be a part of their apprenticeship competition. She got to learn one of the techniques, the saddle wrap, and it isn’t easy, folks! These workers are building America’s future, and we are better for it. Thank you, Ironworkers Local 75!
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftteran?refcode=X_041824_aprcampaignupdate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftteran?refcode=X_041824_aprcampaignupdate]
We had a VIP, Rich Andrade, join our joint Team Terán and Team Ortiz canvassing event! Thank you for your strong support of progressive Latina leaders and your years of service to the people of Maryvale and Glendale.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftteran?refcode=X_041824_aprcampaignupdate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftteran?refcode=X_041824_aprcampaignupdate]
Sometimes, Team Terán turns into Team Dbacks! Raquel, Eddie, and their son EJ attended the first game of the season and were proud to root for their favorite team on their opening day.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftteran?refcode=X_041824_aprcampaignupdate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftteran?refcode=X_041824_aprcampaignupdate]
Raquel was also able to attend the Cesar Chavez Awards Dinner, which saw our community come together to honor the legacy of Cesar Chavez and, of course, Dolores Huerta! Congrats to Dr. Lupita Hightowder for receiving the Cesar Chavez Legacy Award for your incredible work as an educator and leader.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftteran?refcode=X_041824_aprcampaignupdate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftteran?refcode=X_041824_aprcampaignupdate]
And, to everyone who celebrated, Happy Easter from our family to yours! ¡Felices Pascuas!
That’s all for now, Peter! We know our movement is only ramping up from here, and we’ll be stronger with you on board.
If you’re able to, please chip in a few bucks to continue powering us forward. Every dollar makes a difference >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftteran?refcode=X_041824_aprcampaignupdate]
Muchas gracias,
Team Terán
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftteran?refcode=X_041824_aprcampaignupdate]

For nearly 20 years, she's been fighting for higher wages for workers, healthcare for all, and better schools for our children.
She's helped build broad and diverse coalitions that have beaten Republicans like Donald Trump, Joe Arpaio, and Kari Lake.
Now she's ready to take the fight to Congress, but we'll need your support to win. Chip in today! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftteran?refcode=X_041824_aprcampaignupdate]

Attention Mom's & Dad's

| |
---|---|---
|
# Not Marijuana
### Attention Mom's & Dad's
| | Apr 18
---|---
Wake up Parents: Your children can buy intoxicating hemp, even real marijuana, at nearly 2000 stores located throughout Mississippi. In 2018, Congress passed the ["farm bill"](https://substack.com/redirect/70c92ec2-6ba8-4575-8d07-92931f876695?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that allowed for the cultivation and production of hemp and related products. Hemp comes from the same plant as Cannabis but does not contain intoxicating levels of [THC](https://substack.com/redirect/02596b71-fbba-4591-b5ac-edebb6708e22?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--until now! Creative farmers have figured out a way to grow hemp such that it contains dangerous levels of intoxicating substances that are being marketed to children with products like "Nerd Rope" in stores with names like "Pokeman" and "Candy Shop Cannabis". This loophole in the federal legislation is allowing these products to be sold all throughout the country. What is more, these products are totally unregulated. There are no age restrictions and no testing requirements, so we have no idea where these products are coming from or even if they have pesticides or [fentanyl](https://substack.com/redirect/8c68dd70-4616-4fe2-9a8d-78756794d654?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in them. A tiny spec of illegal fentanyl can kill an adult human. They have also been found to have THC; in fact, [recent testing](https://substack.com/redirect/8ce1ca70-5b70-41d7-a057-7c0fe61020e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) has found that some products being sold as "hemp" contain as much as 80% THC--extremely high and dangerous levels. Thankfully, our [Mississippi Legislature](https://substack.com/redirect/7f262eee-1bfb-4c7d-8f8e-8ef983ef01d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is attempting to regulate this [dangerous product,](https://substack.com/redirect/fdcf452d-9de0-45a7-b11d-ece5837433bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at least to ensure that it is tested and can't be sold to children! It is somewhat of a balance, since hemp is still legal as a matter of federal law. For that reason, our legislature is proposing to handle intoxicating hemp in a highly controlled manner, by running it though the medical cannabis program to ensure that it is safe, tested, and only sold to adults over the age of 21.[ House Bill 1676 ](https://substack.com/redirect/c6e0cf4b-33eb-4301-ac7f-c0f6d3f6584a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)would also require intoxicating hemp to only be sold in medical cannabis establishments, which would reduce the locations where it can be sold from nearly 2000 to approximately 150 existing medical facilities--effectively preventing "pot-shops" on every corner in our state. This will provide maximum control over the sale and use of any cannabis or hemp related products. Another recent study found that[ 14% of high school seniors](https://substack.com/redirect/956ec9f1-a3cf-49fc-9c02-5164d87addcc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the Southeast are using legal intoxicating hemp, because they are currently allowed to buy it from locations all over the state without even showing proof of age. We must fix this! Please contact your local [state representative](https://substack.com/redirect/e58dd12a-ce10-457e-bc0c-fc452de44104?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and[ state senator](https://substack.com/redirect/25d036c5-10eb-42ec-866d-cea16fb8ff15?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in your district and support the effort to pass HB 1676 to ensure our children are protected from this dangerous and prevalent new drug!
Brian
(C) 2024 Dan Carr
18237 Hwy 53, Gulfport, MS 39503

body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=6251%2E5257348%2E4JhPg1 ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek, five
years ago today, Special Counsel Robert Mueller’s report on Russian
interference in the 2016 presidential election was released.

His report enumerated all of the interactions between Trump and Russia
during the 2016 campaign. The Trump campaign’s solicitation of Russian
help, how they made use of that help, and how they lied to cover it up.
And although Mueller concluded he could not prove Trump guilty of every
element of the crime of conspiracy beyond a reasonable doubt, (or that he
could prosecute him while he was president) his report also made it clear
that the Trump campaign was only too willing to accept the help of a
hostile foreign power in his election.

Indeed, because he got away with his corrupt conduct during the 2016
campaign, Trump would go on to solicit and attempt to extort help from yet
another foreign power — Ukraine — in the very next election.

In the years since, Republicans censured me in Congress and removed me
from the House Intelligence Committee. And after leading the first
impeachment inquiry against Trump, he launches attacks on my character at
any and every opportunity.

The GOP has tried everything to silence me — but just as I said during the
debate over my censure, I will not yield.

I will not yield to a dangerous man who threatens to “be a dictator on day
one.”

I will not yield to Republican extremists who place loyalty to an
authoritarian figure over truth and justice.

And I will never yield when the very foundations of our democracy are on
the line.

justice, Derek.

Dear Fellow Patriot, As a wrongly accused police officer who was pardoned by President Trump, I’m asking you to sign this **[**Emergency Pardon Petition**](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8jr1utDAQRZ_GdCB7GGxTuPh-RKqUu_3gGS9WzC4CVhF5-ohVlGKauUf3XJqXktMRlPurAKbMmwJQ7R8F8NzbK10u7-tRy-2rfuuucDtD-KcA9mORX_KnpJGZcjm_7n_FAYFMipUE40yLzls01RR8otQnAqbzbOdtZ2xM6DtCB9FXOYAG1Gg8gHGgmz6xcWw6oa5vo9UK9UvUpFVkn_L9Q1amXI4mPuaqhGnfl-01bFAwbBKfqzR0F37sJ6FgKFI4KRhGw37s7Vg7sVSj1W1NbHXNI2rm5G2LWK2Bl89cSt6sU6hvL3V8zN8BAAD__wCUXRw)** because right now a decorated police officer is sitting in prison for doing his job. On December 3, 2019, the Kansas City Police Department observed a red pick-up truck chasing another vehicle through the city streets. Officers unsuccessfully attempted to catch the truck – and involved the department’s helicopter to track it. The chopper tracked the car to the backyard of a home – and Detective Eric DeValkenaere and his partner were the first to arrive at the scene. Eric approached the passenger side of the pick-up and his partner approached the driver’s side, both shouting commands at the driver to STOP and SHOW HIS HANDS. Eric saw the suspect reach toward his waistband and grab a handgun, pointing it directly at his partner. Fearing the suspect would shoot, Eric discharged his firearm four times into the windshield of the pick-up as it continued driving into the garage. When officers entered the garage, they found the suspect deceased with his arm hanging out of the window and his .45 semi-automatic pistol on the ground. (A weapon they would later learn was stolen.) No doubt Eric saved his partner’s life that afternoon – and probably his own. **But instead of receiving an award for his heroic actions, Eric DeValkenaere was charged with Involuntary Manslaughter and Armed Criminal Action by a District Attorney desperately trying to hold onto her elected seat on the bench.** Worse, the Missouri Supreme Court just declined to take Eric’s case – exhausting his options through the justice system. _Even though the Missouri Attorney General agreed Eric is innocent, woke anti-cop prosecutors and the defund the police mob somehow still won!_ **A pardon from Missouri Governor Mike Parson is one of Eric’s last remaining options for freedom.** **[Now you know why I’m asking you to follow this link to sign the Emergency Pardon Petition right away.](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8jr1utDAQRZ_GdCB7GGxTuPh-RKqUu_3gGS9WzC4CVhF5-ohVlGKauUf3XJqXktMRlPurAKbMmwJQ7R8F8NzbK10u7-tRy-2rfuuucDtD-KcA9mORX_KnpJGZcjm_7n_FAYFMipUE40yLzls01RR8otQnAqbzbOdtZ2xM6DtCB9FXOYAG1Gg8gHGgmz6xcWw6oa5vo9UK9UvUpFVkn_L9Q1amXI4mPuaqhGnfl-01bFAwbBKfqzR0F37sJ6FgKFI4KRhGw37s7Vg7sVSj1W1NbHXNI2rm5G2LWK2Bl89cSt6sU6hvL3V8zN8BAAD__wCUXRw)** My name is Stephanie Mohr and I’m proud to be on the Board of Directors for the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund – a non-profit organization that supports and defends wrongly accused officers like Eric. Over the last few years, LELDF has helped many men and women in blue clear their names and win back their freedom. I am also one of those officers LELDF has helped. You see, I used to be a police officer with the Prince George’s County Police Department in Maryland. Then one night I was called to a burglary scene. I did everything by the book – including releasing my canine to apprehend the suspect. We arrested the suspect, an illegal immigrant who was convicted and deported. So, imagine my shock when five years later the U.S. Department of Justice announced it was indicting me for violating the suspect’s civil rights by allowing my canine to bite and hold his leg so we could arrest him. And after two trials – in which the government flew in two illegal alien criminals to testify against me – I was convicted. I spent ten years in prison. But I was one of the lucky ones – not only did I have LELDF helping me fund and mount my defense – but they also helped me secure a pardon from President Trump restoring my good name. That’s why I can’t turn my back on a decorated police officer with a wife and three children at home waiting for him. **And I hope you won’t either.** **[**Will you sign the Emergency Pardon Petition to Missouri Governor Mike Parson right away?**](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8jr1utDAQRZ_GdCB7GGxTuPh-RKqUu_3gGS9WzC4CVhF5-ohVlGKauUf3XJqXktMRlPurAKbMmwJQ7R8F8NzbK10u7-tRy-2rfuuucDtD-KcA9mORX_KnpJGZcjm_7n_FAYFMipUE40yLzls01RR8otQnAqbzbOdtZ2xM6DtCB9FXOYAG1Gg8gHGgmz6xcWw6oa5vo9UK9UvUpFVkn_L9Q1amXI4mPuaqhGnfl-01bFAwbBKfqzR0F37sJ6FgKFI4KRhGw37s7Vg7sVSj1W1NbHXNI2rm5G2LWK2Bl89cSt6sU6hvL3V8zN8BAAD__wCUXRw)** Eric should have been commended for his service and life-saving actions that day, not convicted and sentenced to years in prison! The reality is we can’t get back the last several months Eric has been sitting in prison or the nearly four years this nightmare has been hanging over his head. But with your help today, we can bring Eric home to his wife and three children. **[So please, won’t you take just 30 seconds of your time right now to sign the Emergency Pardon Petition to Governor Mike Parson?](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8jr1utDAQRZ_GdCB7GGxTuPh-RKqUu_3gGS9WzC4CVhF5-ohVlGKauUf3XJqXktMRlPurAKbMmwJQ7R8F8NzbK10u7-tRy-2rfuuucDtD-KcA9mORX_KnpJGZcjm_7n_FAYFMipUE40yLzls01RR8otQnAqbzbOdtZ2xM6DtCB9FXOYAG1Gg8gHGgmz6xcWw6oa5vo9UK9UvUpFVkn_L9Q1amXI4mPuaqhGnfl-01bFAwbBKfqzR0F37sJ6FgKFI4KRhGw37s7Vg7sVSj1W1NbHXNI2rm5G2LWK2Bl89cSt6sU6hvL3V8zN8BAAD__wCUXRw)** After signing the petition, please make a generous donation to LELDF to fund this petition and the legal defenses of eight officers (including Eric) they currently support. Remember, LELDF is able to support wrongly accused and convicted officers like Eric and me because of the generosity of patriots like you. And with a pardon the final option to secure Eric’s freedom and restore his good name, I’m begging you to [**sign the Emergency Pardon Petition today**.](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8jr1utDAQRZ_GdCB7GGxTuPh-RKqUu_3gGS9WzC4CVhF5-ohVlGKauUf3XJqXktMRlPurAKbMmwJQ7R8F8NzbK10u7-tRy-2rfuuucDtD-KcA9mORX_KnpJGZcjm_7n_FAYFMipUE40yLzls01RR8otQnAqbzbOdtZ2xM6DtCB9FXOYAG1Gg8gHGgmz6xcWw6oa5vo9UK9UvUpFVkn_L9Q1amXI4mPuaqhGnfl-01bFAwbBKfqzR0F37sJ6FgKFI4KRhGw37s7Vg7sVSj1W1NbHXNI2rm5G2LWK2Bl89cSt6sU6hvL3V8zN8BAAD__wCUXRw) Thank you in advance for your support.

Stephanie Mohr Director, Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund P.S. clean_body: | | | | Dear Fellow Patriot, As a wrongly accused police officer who was pardoned by President Trump, I’m asking you to sign this because right now a decorated police officer is sitting in prison for doing his job. On December 3, 2019, the Kansas City Police Department observed a red pick-up truck chasing another vehicle through the city streets. Officers unsuccessfully attempted to catch the truck – and involved the department’s helicopter to track it. The chopper tracked the car to the backyard of a home – and Detective Eric DeValkenaere and his partner were the first to arrive at the scene. Eric approached the passenger side of the pick-up and his partner approached the driver’s side, both shouting commands at the driver to STOP and SHOW HIS HANDS. Eric saw the suspect reach toward his waistband and grab a handgun, pointing it directly at his partner. Fearing the suspect would shoot, Eric discharged his firearm four times into the windshield of the pick-up as it continued driving into the garage. When officers entered the garage, they found the suspect deceased with his arm hanging out of the window and his .45 semi-automatic pistol on the ground. (A weapon they would later learn was stolen.) No doubt Eric saved his partner’s life that afternoon – and probably his own. But instead of receiving an award for his heroic actions, Eric DeValkenaere was charged with Involuntary Manslaughter and Armed Criminal Action by a District Attorney desperately trying to hold onto her elected seat on the bench. Worse, the Missouri Supreme Court just declined to take Eric’s case – exhausting his options through the justice system. Even though the Missouri Attorney General agreed Eric is innocent, woke anti-cop prosecutors and the defund the police mob somehow still won! A pardon from Missouri Governor Mike Parson is one of Eric’s last remaining options for freedom. My name is Stephanie Mohr and I’m proud to be on the Board of Directors for the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund – a non-profit organization that supports and defends wrongly accused officers like Eric. Over the last few years, LELDF has helped many men and women in blue clear their names and win back their freedom. I am also one of those officers LELDF has helped. You see, I used to be a police officer with the Prince George’s County Police Department in Maryland. Then one night I was called to a burglary scene. I did everything by the book – including releasing my canine to apprehend the suspect. We arrested the suspect, an illegal immigrant who was convicted and deported. So, imagine my shock when five years later the U.S. Department of Justice announced it was indicting me for violating the suspect’s civil rights by allowing my canine to bite and hold his leg so we could arrest him. And after two trials – in which the government flew in two illegal alien criminals to testify against me – I was convicted. I spent ten years in prison. But I was one of the lucky ones – not only did I have LELDF helping me fund and mount my defense – but they also helped me secure a pardon from President Trump restoring my good name. That’s why I can’t turn my back on a decorated police officer with a wife and three children at home waiting for him. And I hope you won’t either. Eric should have been commended for his service and life-saving actions that day, not convicted and sentenced to years in prison! The reality is we can’t get back the last several months Eric has been sitting in prison or the nearly four years this nightmare has been hanging over his head. But with your help today, we can bring Eric home to his wife and three children. After signing the petition, please make a generous donation to LELDF to fund this petition and the legal defenses of eight officers (including Eric) they currently support. Remember, LELDF is able to support wrongly accused and convicted officers like Eric and me because of the generosity of patriots like you. And with a pardon the final option to secure Eric’s freedom and restore his good name, I’m begging you to Thank you in advance for your support. | | Gratefully, Stephanie Mohr Director, Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund P.S. body:
Grassroots dominated county GOP conventions, while Cook County GOP stands by leader who refuses to call out Boulton’s Trump-Hitler comparison

view in browser (https://mailchi.mp/cd4dbcc2afe3/exclusive-donald-trump-jr-draws-large-crowds-receives-lifetime-membership-10299908?e=1cb5fdae9e) | update preferences (https://illinoisreview.us14.list-manage.com/profile?u=811d47b3c0783e80274d515f7&id=1a5a561027&e=1cb5fdae9e&c=6118de4a1b) | unsubscribe (https://illinoisreview.us14.list-manage.com/unsubscribe?u=811d47b3c0783e80274d515f7&id=1a5a561027&t=b&e=1cb5fdae9e&c=6118de4a1b)

Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to hear about last night's Conservative victories in county conventions statewide. Continue to follow Illinois Review (https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=6118de4a1b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) for more updates.

** Grassroots Dominated County GOP Conventions While Cook County GOP Stands by Leader who Refuses to Call out Boulton’s Trump-Hitler Comparison (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/grassroots-dominated-county-gop-conventions-while-cook-county-gop-stands-by-leader-who-refuses-to-call-out-boultons-trump-hitler-comparison.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=6118de4a1b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/grassroots-dominated-county-gop-conventions-while-cook-county-gop-stands-by-leader-who-refuses-to-call-out-boultons-trump-hitler-comparison.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=6118de4a1b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Donald Trump gives remarks during a Save America Rally at the Adams County Fairgrounds on June 25, 2022, in Mendon, Illinois. (Getty)

By Illinois Review

On Wednesday evening, the President Donald Trump-aligned conservative grassroots – the heart and soul of the Illinois Republican party, secured impressive victories during County GOP conventions – as Republican voters sent a clear message to the out-of-touch establishment that the tide is turning and that power is returning back to the people.

In Cook County, incumbent GOP chairman Sean Morrison maintained his grip on power despite years of poor election results – defeating Dr. Eric Wallace by a large margin – 81,402 to 12,100, while an additional 237 votes were cast as “present.” Chicago continues to have many vacant wards, and several townships did not attend the convention. Wallace is widely respected amongst conservatives, and if elected, he would have become the first African American to serve as Chairman of the Cook County Republican Party.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/grassroots-dominated-county-gop-conventions-while-cook-county-gop-stands-by-leader-who-refuses-to-call-out-boultons-trump-hitler-comparison.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=6118de4a1b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
Dr. Eric Wallace, left, and Chicago Cubs co-owner Todd Ricketts.

In 2023, the Cook County GOP couldn’t recruit or fund a single candidate to run for Chicago mayor in a town of 2.6 million residents, and at one point had 18 vacancies for the position of Chicago ward committeeman under Morrison’s leadership. On the eve of the Cook County Republican Central Committee Convention, Chicago Cubs co-owner Todd Ricketts endorsed Dr. Wallace for chairman, issuing a statement exclusively (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/ir-exclusive-cubs-co-owner-todd-ricketts-issues-statement-endorsing-dr-eric-wallace-for-cook-county-gop-chairman-calling-him-an-asset-to-the-party.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=6118de4a1b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) to Illinois Review late Tuesday afternoon that left Morrison and establishment Republicans in shock, writing,

“I have known Eric for years and think very highly of him. Illinois Republicans should be excited he is getting more involved, and he will be an asset to the party. That is why I am endorsing him for Chairman of the Cook County Republican Party.”

In 2019, President Donald Trump selected Ricketts to serve as Finance Chairman for Trump Victory. Ricketts was also listed as a co-chair for the Palm Beach fundraiser a few weeks ago that raised a record $50.5 million for President Trump’s presidential campaign.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/ir-exclusive-cubs-co-owner-todd-ricketts-issues-statement-endorsing-dr-eric-wallace-for-cook-county-gop-chairman-calling-him-an-asset-to-the-party.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=6118de4a1b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/grassroots-dominated-county-gop-conventions-while-cook-county-gop-stands-by-leader-who-refuses-to-call-out-boultons-trump-hitler-comparison.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=6118de4a1b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/tim-ozinga-suffers-humiliating-defeat-as-conservative-christina-clausen-dominates-will-county-gop-chairman-race.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=6118de4a1b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=6118de4a1b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Christina Clausen, left, and Tim Ozinga.

In McHenry County, the grassroots dominated last night’s election for executive board. Jeff Thorsen will remain Chair of the McHenry County GOP, while newcomer’s Kirk Donald, who ran unopposed will become the new Vice Chair. Additionally, John Pletz was elected Treasurer and Mark Seaquest, Secretary. Sources confirm that as soon as Thorsen was elected, the anti-grassroots slate fell apart. McHenry County will also be sending 19 delegates to the state convention – the most to sign up in decades.

In a sign of unity amongst several grassroots organizations, the nomination of Thorsen came from Bruce Johnson of We the People of McHenry County and it was seconded by Kelly Eagan of McHenry County Conservatives United. McHenry County Conservatives United will be coordinating efforts with various political action committees and grassroot organizations across the county to make certain that McHenry County remains a grassroots county for the foreseeable future.

And in Will County,
Christina Clausen (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/tim-ozinga-suffers-humiliating-defeat-as-conservative-christina-clausen-dominates-will-county-gop-chairman-race.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=6118de4a1b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) – a Donald Trump delegate, secured her position as the new chairwoman of the Will County Republican Central Committee, garnering an impressive victory with 12,220 votes to her opponent’s 6,535 – leaving former Illinois State Rep. Tim Ozinga and his allies in shock and disbelief. Clausen’s victory over Ozinga signals a significant shift towards a conservative agenda. An unapologetic America First patriot, Clausen has been embraced by the party’s conservative grassroots base for her dedication to the conservative cause.

Fellow patriot,

It’s wild to think that one unelected bureaucrat can single-handedly compromise our national security.

Well, fellow patriot, that is precisely what Homeland Security Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas has done. | **Donald Trump Targets DA Alvin Bragg as “Thug” as Criminal Trial Continues** **Listen, we REFUSE to stand idly by while Trump attacks our HERO Alvin Bragg!**

[**We’re sending an urgent letter thanking DA Bragg for holding Trump accountable – but we only have 105 more signature spots available! TO: DA Alvin Bragg
FROM: A grateful Democrat
Subject: Thank you! **_Dear DA Bragg — you’re a HERO!_**

**We cannot begin to tell you the immense sense of relief we felt when we saw Trump had been indicted for his crimes!**

Donald Trump has been free to spout his hateful, treasonous rhetoric for years. _Now, he could FINALLY go to jail where he belongs!_

**Trump knows this trial is TANKING his poll numbers, so he’s going to do everything in his power to take you down.**

**So as Democrats, we wanted you to know we have your back!** [**There are MILLIONS of us across the country who stand with you. That’s why I’m signing this letter and chipping in $3 to the Voter Protection Project to thank you for holding Trump accountable and to elect Democrats who will stand up for our democracy »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/65925?t=8&akid=13856%2E878179%2EwG4_N4) | [Donate $3 to sign now »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/65925?t=9&akid=13856%2E878179%2EwG4_N4)

## Why Do Bad Things Happen To God's People?
---
Many people ask the question: "why do **bad things** happen to **good people**?" That question is _invalid though_ because the Bible says there is none righteous. Which means there are no good people for bad things to happen to... A better question but much tougher question is this: **WHY DO BAD THINGS HAPPEN TO GOD'S PEOPLE?** So many times in life we find ourselves following God yet simultaneously walking through hell. How does that work and why? This last Sunday at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=9136827.4071.1.04057f7307d25fbf8504e6981b272468), we addressed this difficult question that we all face. Watch it here: [WHY DO BAD THINGS HAPPEN TO GOD'S PEOPLE?](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=9136827.4072.1.b7a8cc4d1c8883b407aee90afb5f4167) Thank you,
Pastor Jackson Lahmeyer

body:
| Peter, no one is above the law, including the former president.

This week, we saw former president Trump go on trial for election interference. It’s undeniable that his actions led to a violent insurrection at the U.S. Capitol on January 6.
